title: # Vocabulary Package – Sample (100 words) ## חבילת אוצר מילים – דוגמת פורמט (100 מילים מתוך חבילה של 500) הערה: זוהי דוג
body: # Vocabulary Package – Sample (100 words) ## חבילת אוצר מילים – דוגמת פורמט (100 מילים מתוך חבילה של 500) הערה: זוהי דוגמת פורמט. החבילה המלאה תכיל 500 מילים בחלוקה דומה: - Easy: 150 פעלים, 200 שמות עצם, 100 תארים, 50 תארי פועל/חיבור - כל מילה תכלול: הגדרה באנגלית, תרגום עברי, 2 משפטי דוגמה, מילה נרדפת (synonym), מילה נגדית (antonym), הערה לזכרון --- ## Section A: Verbs (פעלים) – 30 מילים דוגמה ### 1. achieve (v.) - Definition: to successfully reach or accomplish a goal through effort - תרגום: להשיג, להצליח להגיע אל - Example 1: She worked hard for years to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor. - Example 2: The team achieved remarkable results in the final quarter. - Synonyms: accomplish, attain, reach - Antonyms: fail, miss - 💡 Memory tip: From Old French *achever* ("to finish"). Think: "A-chief (leader) achieves things." ### 2. acquire (v.) - Definition: to come to own or possess something, often through effort - תרגום: לרכוש, לקנות, להשיג - Example 1: Over the years, the museum acquired a vast collection of rare paintings. - Example 2: Children acquire language skills naturally in their early years. - Synonyms: obtain, gain, procure - Antonyms: lose, forfeit - 💡 Memory tip: Think "a-cure" – you acquire the cure. ### 3. analyze (v.) - Definition: to examine something in detail in order to understand it - תרגום: לנתח - Example 1: Scientists must analyze the data carefully before reaching a conclusion. - Example 2: The teacher asked her students to analyze the poem's structure. - Synonyms: examine, investigate, study - Antonyms: synthesize, combine - 💡 Memory tip: "Anal-ysis" – looking at the small parts of something. ### 4. approach (v.) - Definition: to come near to; to begin to deal with something - תרגום: להתקרב אל; לגשת אל (נושא) - Example 1: As winter approaches, the days become shorter. - Example 2: We need a new way to approach this problem. - Synonyms: near, tackle, address - Antonyms: retreat, avoid ### 5. argue (v.) - Definition: to give reasons for or against something; to disagree verbally - תרגום: לטעון; להתווכח - Example 1: Many economists argue that inflation will rise next year. - Example 2: The couple argued about money for hours. - Synonyms: claim, contend, debate, quarrel - Antonyms: agree, concur ### 6. assume (v.) - Definition: to believe something is true without proof; to take on a role or responsibility - תרגום: להניח; לקבל על עצמו (תפקיד) - Example 1: I assumed you were coming to the meeting. - Example 2: She will assume the role of director next month. - Synonyms: presume, suppose, undertake - Antonyms: doubt, question ### 7. attempt (v.) - Definition: to make an effort to do something - תרגום: לנסות, לעשות מאמץ - Example 1: He attempted to climb the mountain but had to turn back. - Example 2: The students will attempt the final exam tomorrow. - Synonyms: try, endeavor, strive - Antonyms: give up, abandon ### 8. avoid (v.) - Definition: to stay away from; to prevent something from happening - תרגום: להימנע מ- - Example 1: You should avoid junk food if you want to stay healthy. - Example 2: The driver swerved to avoid the dog. - Synonyms: evade, escape, dodge - Antonyms: confront, face, encounter ### 9. believe (v.) - Definition: to accept as true; to have faith in - תרגום: להאמין - Example 1: Scientists do not believe that theory is supported by evidence. - Example 2: She believes in the power of education. - Synonyms: trust, accept, think - Antonyms: doubt, disbelieve, reject ### 10. create (v.) - Definition: to bring something into existence; to produce - תרגום: ליצור, לברוא - Example 1: The artist created a masterpiece in just three days. - Example 2: New technology is creating jobs in many industries. - Synonyms: produce, generate, form, make - Antonyms: destroy, demolish ### 11. decide (v.) - Definition: to make a choice after thinking - תרגום: להחליט - Example 1: We haven't decided where to go on vacation yet. - Example 2: The judge will decide the case next week. - Synonyms: determine, choose, resolve - Antonyms: hesitate, waver ### 12. describe (v.) - Definition: to say what someone or something is like - תרגום: לתאר - Example 1: Can you describe the man you saw? - Example 2: The article describes how the disease spreads. - Synonyms: portray, depict, explain - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) ### 13. develop (v.) - Definition: to grow or cause to grow and become more advanced - תרגום: לפתח, להתפתח - Example 1: The country has developed rapidly over the past decade. - Example 2: She developed a new method for testing water quality. - Synonyms: grow, evolve, advance, progress - Antonyms: regress, decline, deteriorate ### 14. discover (v.) - Definition: to find something new, especially a place, fact, or phenomenon - תרגום: לגלות - Example 1: Columbus is said to have discovered America in 1492. - Example 2: Researchers discovered a new species of fish in the deep ocean. - Synonyms: find, uncover, reveal, detect - Antonyms: hide, conceal, overlook ### 15. encourage (v.) - Definition: to give someone support, confidence, or hope - תרגום: לעודד - Example 1: My parents always encouraged me to read. - Example 2: These rewards are designed to encourage good behavior. - Synonyms: motivate, inspire, support - Antonyms: discourage, dissuade ### 16. establish (v.) - Definition: to set up or create something that is meant to last - תרגום: לייסד, לבסס - Example 1: The university was established in 1925. - Example 2: The company has established a strong reputation in the field. - Synonyms: found, create, institute - Antonyms: abolish, dissolve ### 17. exist (v.) - Definition: to be present in the real world; to live - תרגום: להתקיים, להיות קיים - Example 1: Many rare species still exist in the Amazon rainforest. - Example 2: The theory suggests that parallel universes may exist. - Synonyms: be, live, remain - Antonyms: vanish, cease ### 18. expect (v.) - Definition: to believe something will happen - תרגום: לצפות, לחכות ל- - Example 1: We expect the rain to stop by evening. - Example 2: She didn't expect such a warm welcome. - Synonyms: anticipate, predict, foresee - Antonyms: be surprised by ### 19. explain (v.) - Definition: to make something clear by describing it - תרגום: להסביר - Example 1: Could you explain the rules of the game? - Example 2: He explained why he was late. - Synonyms: clarify, illustrate, describe - Antonyms: confuse, mystify ### 20. explore (v.) - Definition: to travel through a place to learn about it; to examine an idea - תרגום: לחקור, לתור - Example 1: The team set out to explore the unknown cave. - Example 2: The book explores the question of free will. - Synonyms: investigate, examine, survey - Antonyms: ignore, overlook ### 21. grow (v.) - Definition: to become larger or develop - תרגום: לגדול, לצמוח - Example 1: The plant grew three inches in one week. - Example 2: The company has grown rapidly since 2020. - Synonyms: increase, expand, develop - Antonyms: shrink, decline ### 22. happen (v.) - Definition: to take place; to occur - תרגום: לקרות, להתרחש - Example 1: Nothing unusual happened yesterday. - Example 2: Can you tell me what happened at the meeting? - Synonyms: occur, take place, arise - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) ### 23. improve (v.) - Definition: to make or become better - תרגום: לשפר, להשתפר - Example 1: Practice will help you improve your English. - Example 2: The weather should improve tomorrow. - Synonyms: enhance, upgrade, refine - Antonyms: worsen, deteriorate ### 24. include (v.) - Definition: to have as part of a whole - תרגום: לכלול - Example 1: The price includes breakfast. - Example 2: The report includes several important recommendations. - Synonyms: contain, comprise, incorporate - Antonyms: exclude, omit ### 25. increase (v.) - Definition: to become greater in number or amount - תרגום: להגדיל, לעלות - Example 1: The population of the city has increased sharply. - Example 2: Exercise increases your energy levels. - Synonyms: rise, grow, expand - Antonyms: decrease, reduce, diminish ### 26. learn (v.) - Definition: to gain knowledge or skill - תרגום: ללמוד - Example 1: Children learn languages more easily than adults. - Example 2: I learned about the news this morning. - Synonyms: study, master, acquire - Antonyms: forget, unlearn ### 27. occur (v.) - Definition: to happen, especially without being planned - תרגום: לקרות, להתרחש (פורמלי יותר) - Example 1: The accident occurred at 3 a.m. - Example 2: Earthquakes often occur along fault lines. - Synonyms: happen, take place, arise - Antonyms: (no direct antonym) - 💡 Memory tip: More formal/academic than "happen" – use in reading comprehension texts. ### 28. prove (v.) - Definition: to show that something is true with evidence - תרגום: להוכיח - Example 1: The test proved that the water was safe to drink. - Example 2: Can you prove your claim? - Synonyms: demonstrate, confirm, verify - Antonyms: disprove, refute ### 29. recognize (v.) - Definition: to know someone or something because you have seen them before; to accept as true - תרגום: לזהות; להכיר ב- - Example 1: I didn't recognize him with his new haircut. - Example 2: The company recognized her hard work with a promotion. - Synonyms: identify, acknowledge - Antonyms: ignore, overlook ### 30. suggest (v.) - Definition: to propose an idea; to indicate something without saying it directly - תרגום: להציע; לרמוז - Example 1: I suggest that we meet at 7 p.m. - Example 2: The results suggest that the treatment is effective. - Synonyms: propose, recommend, imply - Antonyms: demand, insist --- ## Section B: Nouns (שמות עצם) – 40 מילים דוגמה ### 31. ability (n.) - Definition: the power or skill to do something - תרגום: יכולת, כישרון - Example: She has the ability to solve complex problems quickly. - Synonyms: capability, skill, talent - Antonyms: inability, incompetence ### 32. advantage (n.) - Definition: a benefit or favorable position - תרגום: יתרון - Example: Speaking two languages can be a great advantage in business. - Synonyms: benefit, asset, strength - Antonyms: disadvantage, drawback ### 33. attempt (n.) - Definition: an effort to do something - תרגום: ניסיון, מאמץ - Example: This is my third attempt to pass the test. - Synonyms: effort, try, endeavor - Antonyms: abandonment ### 34. behavior (n.) - Definition: the way a person or animal acts - תרגום: התנהגות - Example: The teacher praised the students' behavior during the trip. - Synonyms: conduct, manner, actions ### 35. benefit (n.) - Definition: an advantage or gain - תרגום: תועלת, הטבה - Example: Regular exercise has many health benefits. - Synonyms: advantage, gain, profit - Antonyms: disadvantage, harm ### 36. challenge (n.) - Definition: a difficult task or situation - תרגום: אתגר - Example: Learning a new language is a real challenge. - Synonyms: difficulty, task, test - Antonyms: ease, simplicity ### 37. consequence (n.) - Definition: a result or effect of an action - תרגום: תוצאה, השלכה - Example: Climate change has serious consequences for our planet. - Synonyms: result, outcome, effect - Antonyms: cause - 💡 Memory tip: Usually refers to NEGATIVE results. Positive results = "benefits" or "outcomes." ### 38. decision (n.) - Definition: a choice made after thinking - תרגום: החלטה - Example: Making the right decision can change your life. - Synonyms: choice, judgment, resolution - Antonyms: indecision, hesitation ### 39. difference (n.) - Definition: a way in which things are not the same - תרגום: הבדל - Example: What is the difference between these two theories? - Synonyms: distinction, contrast - Antonyms: similarity, resemblance ### 40. effect (n.) - Definition: a result; the change caused by something - תרגום: השפעה, אפקט - Example: The new law had a positive effect on the economy. - Synonyms: result, outcome, consequence - Antonyms: cause, source - ⚠️ Don't confuse with: "affect" (verb, to influence) vs. "effect" (noun, a result). "The weather affects my mood" vs. "The effect of the weather is clear." ### 41. evidence (n.) - Defin

title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## Vocabulary Package 1 – Basic Level (500 מילים) מבנה: 500 מילים בסיסיות במקצועיות קהל
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## Vocabulary Package 1 – Basic Level (500 מילים) מבנה: 500 מילים בסיסיות במקצועיות קהל יעד: רמת יציאה בסיסית (3 יח"ל תיכון ומטה) מטרה: שליטה מלאה כתשתית ללמידה המשך --- ## 📋 מבנה החבילה | סוג מילה | מספר מילים | מתאים ל- | |---|---|---| | פעלים (Verbs) | 150 | פעולות יומיומיות | | שמות עצם (Nouns) | 200 | חפצים, מושגים | | תארים (Adjectives) | 100 | תיאורים | | תארי פועל ומילות קישור | 50 | מילים קושרות | | סה"כ | 500 | | ## 🎯 איך להשתמש בחבילה הזו? ### הגישה המומלצת – Spaced Repetition: 1. יום 1: למד 20-25 מילים חדשות 2. יום 2: חזור על 20-25 אלה + עוד 20-25 חדשות 3. יום 3: חזור על הכל + 20-25 חדשות 4. יום 7: בדוק את כל מה שלמדת השבוע ### מבנה כל מילה: - 📖 Definition - הגדרה באנגלית (חשוב להבין באנגלית, לא רק לתרגם) - 🇮🇱 תרגום - לעברית - 📝 Example 1 & 2 - שני משפטי דוגמה - 🔁 Synonyms - מילים נרדפות - ↔️ Antonyms - מילים נגדיות - 💡 Memory tip - טיפ לזכרון --- # 📘 חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) > טיפ: פעלים הם הלב של השפה. שליטה ב-150 פעלים הבסיסיים = יכולת להביע כמעט כל רעיון. ## 🟢 Section A1: פעלי יומיום בסיסיים (1-30) ### 1. be (v.) - Definition: to exist; to have a particular quality or state - תרגום: להיות - Example 1: I am a student at the university. - Example 2: The book is on the table. - Synonyms: exist, remain - Antonyms: (none - unique verb) - 💡 Memory tip: הפועל הכי בסיסי באנגלית. Forms: am/is/are/was/were/been. ### 2. have (v.) - Definition: to possess or own; to experience - תרגום: להיות ל-, להחזיק - Example 1: She has two brothers. - Example 2: We have a meeting at 3 PM. - Synonyms: possess, own - Antonyms: lack - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: have/has/had. משמש גם לזמני Perfect: "I have eaten". ### 3. do (v.) - Definition: to perform an action; to complete - תרגום: לעשות - Example 1: What do you do for work? - Example 2: She did her homework quickly. - Synonyms: perform, carry out - Antonyms: undo - 💡 Memory tip: עוזר הפועל הכי נפוץ לשאלות בהווה: "Do you like...?" ### 4. go (v.) - Definition: to move from one place to another - תרגום: ללכת, להגיע ל- - Example 1: I go to school every day. - Example 2: They went to Paris last summer. - Synonyms: travel, move, head - Antonyms: stay, remain, come - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: go/goes/went/gone. Past = "went" (לא "goed"). ### 5. come (v.) - Definition: to move toward a place; to arrive - תרגום: לבוא, להגיע - Example 1: Please come to my party on Friday. - Example 2: She came home late last night. - Synonyms: arrive, approach - Antonyms: go, leave - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: come/comes/came/come. "Come" נשאר גם בעבר השלישי. ### 6. see (v.) - Definition: to perceive with the eyes; to understand - תרגום: לראות; להבין - Example 1: I can see the mountains from my window. - Example 2: I see what you mean now. - Synonyms: look at, observe; understand - Antonyms: miss, ignore - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: see/sees/saw/seen. ### 7. look (v.) - Definition: to direct your eyes somewhere; to appear - תרגום: להסתכל; להיראות - Example 1: Look at the beautiful sunset! - Example 2: You look tired today. - Synonyms: glance, appear, seem - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל חשוב: see = תופס בעין (פסיבי), look = מכוון מבט (אקטיבי). ### 8. watch (v.) - Definition: to look at something for a period of time - תרגום: לצפות, לשמור על - Example 1: We watched a great movie last night. - Example 2: Please watch my bag while I use the bathroom. - Synonyms: observe, view - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: look at = רגע קצר; watch = לאורך זמן. ### 9. hear (v.) - Definition: to perceive with the ears - תרגום: לשמוע - Example 1: Did you hear that strange noise? - Example 2: I heard the news this morning. - Synonyms: listen, detect - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: hear = תופס באוזן; listen = מקשיב במכוון. Forms: hear/hears/heard/heard. ### 10. listen (v.) - Definition: to pay attention to sounds - תרגום: להקשיב, להאזין - Example 1: Listen carefully to the instructions. - Example 2: She loves to listen to classical music. - Synonyms: hear attentively - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: listen to (עם to). "Listen music" = שגוי. ### 11. say (v.) - Definition: to speak words; to state - תרגום: לומר - Example 1: What did you say? - Example 2: She said she was tired. - Synonyms: state, mention, declare - Antonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: say to someone. Forms: say/says/said/said. ### 12. tell (v.) - Definition: to communicate information to someone - תרגום: לספר, להגיד ל- - Example 1: Tell me about your day. - Example 2: He told her the truth. - Synonyms: inform, relate - Antonyms: hide, conceal - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: say = "say that" (ללא אובייקט מיידי); tell = "tell someone" (עם אובייקט). Forms: tell/tells/told/told. ### 13. speak (v.) - Definition: to use the voice to produce words - תרגום: לדבר - Example 1: Do you speak English? - Example 2: The president will speak at 8 PM. - Synonyms: talk, converse - Antonyms: be silent - 💡 Memory tip: speak a language. Forms: speak/speaks/spoke/spoken. ### 14. talk (v.) - Definition: to speak in conversation - תרגום: לדבר (שיחה) - Example 1: We talked for hours on the phone. - Example 2: Can we talk about this later? - Synonyms: converse, chat - Antonyms: be silent - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: speak = פורמלי יותר; talk = שיחה יומיומית. talk to/with someone. ### 15. think (v.) - Definition: to use your mind; to have an opinion - תרגום: לחשוב - Example 1: Let me think about it. - Example 2: I think you're right. - Synonyms: consider, believe - Antonyms: (none direct) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: think/thinks/thought/thought. think about X = לחשוב על X. ### 16. know (v.) - Definition: to have information; to be familiar with - תרגום: לדעת, להכיר - Example 1: I know the answer. - Example 2: Do you know my sister? - Synonyms: understand, recognize - Antonyms: not know, be unaware - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: know/knows/knew/known. "K" שקט! ### 17. understand (v.) - Definition: to grasp the meaning of something - תרגום: להבין - Example 1: I don't understand this question. - Example 2: She understood the lesson quickly. - Synonyms: comprehend, grasp - Antonyms: misunderstand - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: understand/understands/understood/understood. ### 18. learn (v.) - Definition: to acquire knowledge or skill - תרגום: ללמוד - Example 1: I want to learn how to cook. - Example 2: Children learn languages easily. - Synonyms: study, discover - Antonyms: forget, unlearn - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: learn = לרכוש ידע (תהליך פעיל); study = לחקור (בתהליך מסודר). ### 19. study (v.) - Definition: to examine carefully; to pursue academic learning - תרגום: ללמוד (במסגרת מסודרת), לחקור - Example 1: She studies biology at university. - Example 2: I need to study for the test tomorrow. - Synonyms: research, examine, learn - Antonyms: ignore - 💡 Memory tip: באנגלית אקדמית, study הוא פועל חשוב: "studies show that...". ### 20. teach (v.) - Definition: to give instruction to someone - תרגום: ללמד, להורות - Example 1: My mother teaches math. - Example 2: He taught me how to drive. - Synonyms: instruct, educate - Antonyms: learn (opposite direction) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: teach/teaches/taught/taught. ### 21. read (v.) - Definition: to look at written words and understand them - תרגום: לקרוא - Example 1: I read a book every week. - Example 2: She read the newspaper this morning. - Synonyms: study, peruse - Antonyms: (none direct) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: read/reads/read/read. בעבר, המילה כתובה זהה אבל הגיית "red"! ### 22. write (v.) - Definition: to make letters or words on a surface - תרגום: לכתוב - Example 1: Please write your name here. - Example 2: She wrote a long letter to her friend. - Synonyms: compose, record - Antonyms: erase, delete - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: write/writes/wrote/written. ### 23. eat (v.) - Definition: to consume food - תרגום: לאכול - Example 1: What do you want to eat for dinner? - Example 2: We ate pizza last night. - Synonyms: consume, devour - Antonyms: starve, fast - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: eat/eats/ate/eaten. ### 24. drink (v.) - Definition: to consume a liquid - תרגום: לשתות - Example 1: Drink plenty of water during exercise. - Example 2: He drank three cups of coffee. - Synonyms: sip, swallow - Antonyms: (none direct) - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: drink/drinks/drank/drunk. ### 25. sleep (v.) - Definition: to rest with closed eyes in unconsciousness - תרגום: לישון - Example 1: I sleep for eight hours every night. - Example 2: The baby slept peacefully. - Synonyms: rest, slumber - Antonyms: wake up, be awake - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: sleep/sleeps/slept/slept. ### 26. wake (v.) / wake up - Definition: to stop sleeping - תרגום: להתעורר - Example 1: I usually wake up at 7 AM. - Example 2: The noise woke the baby. - Synonyms: arise, rise - Antonyms: sleep, fall asleep - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: wake/wakes/woke/woken. ### 27. work (v.) - Definition: to do a job; to function properly - תרגום: לעבוד; לפעול - Example 1: She works at a hospital. - Example 2: My computer doesn't work. - Synonyms: labor, function, operate - Antonyms: rest; break down - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "I have a lot of work." ### 28. play (v.) - Definition: to engage in a game; to perform music - תרגום: לשחק; לנגן - Example 1: The children are playing in the park. - Example 2: She plays the piano beautifully. - Synonyms: enjoy, perform - Antonyms: work - 💡 Memory tip: play a sport/game, play an instrument. ### 29. run (v.) - Definition: to move fast on foot; to operate - תרגום: לרוץ; להפעיל - Example 1: He runs five miles every morning. - Example 2: She runs her own business. - Synonyms: sprint, manage - Antonyms: walk; stop - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: run/runs/ran/run. ### 30. walk (v.) - Definition: to move on foot at a normal pace - תרגום: ללכת, לצעוד - Example 1: I walk to work every day. - Example 2: Let's walk in the park. - Synonyms: stroll, stride - Antonyms: run, ride - 💡 Memory tip: Regular verb: walk/walked/walked. --- ## 🟢 Section A2: פעלים יומיומיים נוספים (31-60) ### 31. sit (v.) - Definition: to rest on your bottom - תרגום: לשבת - Example 1: Please sit down. - Example 2: We sat by the fire all evening. - Synonyms: be seated - Antonyms: stand, rise - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: sit/sits/sat/sat. ### 32. stand (v.) - Definition: to be on your feet in an upright position - תרגום: לעמוד - Example 1: She stood by the window for hours. - Example 2: Please stand when the judge enters. - Synonyms: rise, be upright - Antonyms: sit, lie - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: stand/stands/stood/stood. ### 33. live (v.) - Definition: to be alive; to reside somewhere - תרגום: לחיות; לגור - Example 1: We live in Tel Aviv. - Example 2: My grandfather lived to be 95. - Synonyms: reside, exist, dwell - Antonyms: die - 💡 Memory tip: pronunciation: /lɪv/ (פועל) vs. /laɪv/ (live, תואר = חי). ### 34. die (v.) - Definition: to stop living - תרגום: למות - Example 1: The plant died because I forgot to water it. - Example 2: She's afraid to die alone. - Synonyms: pass away, perish - Antonyms: live, survive - 💡 Memory tip: -ing form: dying (not dieing!). ### 35. love (v.) - Definition: to have deep affection for - תרגום: לאהוב - Example 1: I love my family. - Example 2: She loves chocolate. - Synonyms: adore, cherish - Antonyms: hate, dislike - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "love is beautiful". ### 36. like (v.) - Definition: to find something enjoyable - תרגום: לאהוב (פחות חזק מ-love) - Example 1: I like your new dress. - Example 2: She likes playing tennis. - Synonyms: enjoy, fancy - Antonyms: dislike, hate - 💡 Memory tip: like + V-ing (like playing) או like + to V (like to play). ### 37. want (v.) - Definition: to desire something - תרגום: לרצות - Example 1: I want to go home. - Example 2: Do you want some coffee? - Synonyms: wish, desire - Antonyms: refuse - 💡 Memory tip: want + to V (want to go), want + noun (want a car). ### 38. need (v.) - Definition: to require something; to have a necessity - תרגום: להזדקק, להצטרך - Example 1: We need more time to finish this. - Example 2: The plant needs water. - Synonyms: require, demand - Antonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: w

title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## חלק ב': 200 שמות עצם (Nouns) מבנה החלק: 200 שמות עצם בסיסיים מחולקים ל-6 קטגוריות --
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## חלק ב': 200 שמות עצם (Nouns) מבנה החלק: 200 שמות עצם בסיסיים מחולקים ל-6 קטגוריות --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. אנשים ויחסי משפחה (151-180) - 30 מילים 2. מקומות ומיקומים (181-210) - 30 מילים 3. זמן ותאריכים (211-240) - 30 מילים 4. חפצים ופריטים (241-280) - 40 מילים 5. מזון ושתייה (281-310) - 30 מילים 6. מושגים מופשטים (311-350) - 40 מילים --- # 👥 קטגוריה 1: אנשים ויחסי משפחה (30 מילים) ### 151. person (n.) - Definition: a human being - תרגום: אדם, בן אדם - Example 1: He is a nice person. - Example 2: Each person has unique talents. - Synonyms: individual, human - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: people (לא "persons" באנגלית יומיומית). ### 152. people (n.) - Definition: human beings in general (plural) - תרגום: אנשים - Example 1: Many people came to the concert. - Example 2: People are different from each other. - Synonyms: humans, individuals - 💡 Memory tip: תמיד ברבים - "people are" (לא "people is"). ### 153. man (n.) - Definition: an adult male human - תרגום: גבר, איש - Example 1: The man at the door is my neighbor. - Example 2: A young man helped me. - Synonyms: male, gentleman - Antonyms: woman - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: men (לא "mans"). ### 154. woman (n.) - Definition: an adult female human - תרגום: אישה - Example 1: The woman next to me was reading. - Example 2: She's a successful woman. - Synonyms: female, lady - Antonyms: man - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: women (הגייה: /wɪmɪn/). ### 155. child (n.) - Definition: a young human being - תרגום: ילד, ילדה - Example 1: The child is playing in the park. - Example 2: Every child deserves love. - Synonyms: kid, youngster - Antonyms: adult - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: children (לא "childs"!). ### 156. boy (n.) - Definition: a young male - תרגום: ילד, נער - Example 1: The boy is reading a book. - Example 2: He was a shy boy. - Synonyms: lad, youth - Antonyms: girl - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: boys. ### 157. girl (n.) - Definition: a young female - תרגום: ילדה, נערה - Example 1: The girl won the prize. - Example 2: She's a talented girl. - Synonyms: young woman - Antonyms: boy - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: girls. ### 158. family (n.) - Definition: a group of related people - תרגום: משפחה - Example 1: My family is large. - Example 2: She comes from a musical family. - Synonyms: relatives, kin - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: families. ### 159. mother (n.) / mom/mum - Definition: a female parent - תרגום: אם, אמא - Example 1: My mother is a doctor. - Example 2: Mom, can you help me? - Synonyms: mom (informal) - Antonyms: father - 💡 Memory tip: mom (אמריקאי) / mum (בריטי). ### 160. father (n.) / dad - Definition: a male parent - תרגום: אב, אבא - Example 1: My father works at a bank. - Example 2: Dad, where are you? - Synonyms: dad (informal) - Antonyms: mother - 💡 Memory tip: "dad" - צורה לא פורמלית, משפחתית. ### 161. parent (n.) - Definition: a father or mother - תרגום: הורה - Example 1: My parents live in Haifa. - Example 2: Being a parent is challenging. - Synonyms: mother/father - 💡 Memory tip: תמיד ברבים לפרטית - "my parents". ### 162. brother (n.) - Definition: a male sibling - תרגום: אח - Example 1: I have two brothers. - Example 2: My older brother is a teacher. - Synonyms: sibling - Antonyms: sister - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: brothers. ### 163. sister (n.) - Definition: a female sibling - תרגום: אחות - Example 1: My sister lives in Jerusalem. - Example 2: She's my younger sister. - Synonyms: sibling - Antonyms: brother - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: sisters. ### 164. son (n.) - Definition: a male child of parents - תרגום: בן - Example 1: Their son is studying medicine. - Example 2: She has one son and two daughters. - Synonyms: (none) - Antonyms: daughter - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: /sʌn/ - כמו "sun" (שמש). ### 165. daughter (n.) - Definition: a female child of parents - תרגום: בת - Example 1: Their daughter is getting married. - Example 2: I have three daughters. - Synonyms: (none) - Antonyms: son - 💡 Memory tip: "augh" = /ɔː/ (ה-gh שקטה!). ### 166. husband (n.) - Definition: a married man - תרגום: בעל - Example 1: Her husband is a lawyer. - Example 2: My husband cooks dinner. - Synonyms: spouse - Antonyms: wife - 💡 Memory tip: pronunciation: /ˈhʌzbənd/. ### 167. wife (n.) - Definition: a married woman - תרגום: אישה (נשואה) - Example 1: My wife loves gardening. - Example 2: His wife is a nurse. - Synonyms: spouse - Antonyms: husband - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: wives (לא "wifes"). ### 168. friend (n.) - Definition: a person you know and like - תרגום: חבר - Example 1: She is my best friend. - Example 2: I met a new friend at work. - Synonyms: buddy, companion, pal - Antonyms: enemy, stranger - 💡 Memory tip: make friends with X = להתיידד עם X. ### 169. neighbor (n.) / neighbour (British) - Definition: a person who lives near you - תרגום: שכן - Example 1: My neighbor is very friendly. - Example 2: The neighbors are having a party. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: איות אמריקאי: neighbor. בריטי: neighbour. ### 170. teacher (n.) - Definition: a person who teaches - תרגום: מורה - Example 1: My English teacher is excellent. - Example 2: She's a teacher at a high school. - Synonyms: instructor, educator - Antonyms: student - 💡 Memory tip: From "teach" + "-er" (who does the teaching). ### 171. student (n.) - Definition: a person who studies - תרגום: תלמיד, סטודנט - Example 1: She's a good student. - Example 2: The students are preparing for exams. - Synonyms: learner, pupil - Antonyms: teacher - 💡 Memory tip: בישראל: "סטודנט" = באוניברסיטה; "תלמיד" = בבית ספר. ### 172. doctor (n.) - Definition: a medical professional - תרגום: רופא - Example 1: Call the doctor if you feel worse. - Example 2: She wants to be a doctor. - Synonyms: physician, medic - 💡 Memory tip: קיצור: "Dr." = Doctor. ### 173. nurse (n.) - Definition: a person who cares for the sick - תרגום: אח/אחות (רפואית) - Example 1: The nurse gave him medicine. - Example 2: She works as a nurse at the hospital. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: "nurse a baby" = להאכיל תינוק. ### 174. boss (n.) - Definition: a person in charge - תרגום: בוס, מנהל - Example 1: My boss gave me a raise. - Example 2: He's the boss of the company. - Synonyms: manager, supervisor, chief - Antonyms: employee, worker - 💡 Memory tip: לא פורמלי. בעברית רשמית: manager. ### 175. worker (n.) - Definition: a person who works - תרגום: עובד, פועל - Example 1: The construction workers arrived early. - Example 2: She's a hard worker. - Synonyms: employee, laborer - Antonyms: boss (in some contexts) - 💡 Memory tip: work + -er = מי שעובד. ### 176. president (n.) - Definition: the leader of a country or organization - תרגום: נשיא - Example 1: The president gave a speech. - Example 2: Who is the president of Israel? - Synonyms: leader, chief - 💡 Memory tip: לפני שם: "President Biden". ### 177. king (n.) - Definition: a male royal ruler - תרגום: מלך - Example 1: The king lives in a palace. - Example 2: He's the king of England. - Synonyms: ruler, monarch - Antonyms: queen - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: kings. ### 178. queen (n.) - Definition: a female royal ruler - תרגום: מלכה - Example 1: The queen waved to the crowd. - Example 2: She lived like a queen. - Synonyms: ruler, monarch - Antonyms: king - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: queens. ### 179. stranger (n.) - Definition: a person you don't know - תרגום: זר, לא מוכר - Example 1: Don't talk to strangers. - Example 2: A stranger helped me find the way. - Synonyms: unknown person, outsider - Antonyms: friend, acquaintance - 💡 Memory tip: From "strange" (מוזר, לא מוכר). ### 180. guest (n.) - Definition: a visitor invited somewhere - תרגום: אורח - Example 1: We have guests tonight. - Example 2: Please treat our guest well. - Synonyms: visitor - Antonyms: host - 💡 Memory tip: זהירות: guest ≠ guess (לנחש)! --- # 🏠 קטגוריה 2: מקומות ומיקומים (30 מילים) ### 181. place (n.) - Definition: a location or area - תרגום: מקום - Example 1: This is a nice place to relax. - Example 2: I've been to many places in Europe. - Synonyms: location, spot, area - 💡 Memory tip: כללי מאוד - שימוש רב-תכליתי. ### 182. home (n.) - Definition: the place where you live - תרגום: בית (המקום, הרגש) - Example 1: I'm going home. - Example 2: There's no place like home. - Synonyms: house, residence - 💡 Memory tip: הבדל: home = בית כרגש/מושג; house = בית כמבנה פיזי. ### 183. house (n.) - Definition: a building where people live - תרגום: בית (מבנה) - Example 1: They bought a new house. - Example 2: The house has three bedrooms. - Synonyms: building, residence - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: houses (הגייה: /ˈhaʊzɪz/). ### 184. apartment (n.) / flat (British) - Definition: a home in a large building - תרגום: דירה - Example 1: I live in a small apartment. - Example 2: My apartment is on the third floor. - Synonyms: flat (British) - 💡 Memory tip: אמריקאי: apartment. בריטי: flat. ### 185. room (n.) - Definition: a part of a building - תרגום: חדר; מקום - Example 1: My room is upstairs. - Example 2: There's no room for us all in the car. - Synonyms: space, chamber - 💡 Memory tip: גם "space" - "is there room for me?". ### 186. kitchen (n.) - Definition: the room where you cook - תרגום: מטבח - Example 1: She's in the kitchen. - Example 2: Our kitchen is small but modern. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: "kitchen" = place where you "catch" food to cook (עזר לזכור). ### 187. bedroom (n.) - Definition: a room for sleeping - תרגום: חדר שינה - Example 1: The bedroom is painted blue. - Example 2: I have my own bedroom. - Synonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: bed + room = bedroom. ### 188. bathroom (n.) - Definition: a room with a toilet/shower - תרגום: חדר אמבטיה, שירותים - Example 1: Where's the bathroom? - Example 2: The bathroom needs cleaning. - Synonyms: washroom, restroom (American) - 💡 Memory tip: bath + room = bathroom. ### 189. garden (n.) - Definition: an area of land with plants - תרגום: גינה - Example 1: We have a small garden behind the house. - Example 2: She's working in the garden. - Synonyms: yard (American) - 💡 Memory tip: "Kindergarten" = גן ילדים (מגרמנית). ### 190. city (n.) - Definition: a large town - תרגום: עיר - Example 1: Tel Aviv is a big city. - Example 2: She loves living in the city. - Synonyms: metropolis, urban area - Antonyms: village, country - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: cities. ### 191. town (n.) - Definition: a small to medium-sized city - תרגום: עיירה - Example 1: It's a quiet town. - Example 2: The town has only one supermarket. - Synonyms: municipality - Antonyms: village (smaller), city (larger) - 💡 Memory tip: קטן יותר מ-city, גדול יותר מ-village. ### 192. village (n.) - Definition: a small community in the countryside - תרגום: כפר - Example 1: She grew up in a small village. - Example 2: The village has only 200 people. - Synonyms: hamlet - Antonyms: city - 💡 Memory tip: זעיר יותר מ-town. ### 193. country (n.) - Definition: a nation; rural area - תרגום: מדינה; אזור כפרי - Example 1: Israel is a small country. - Example 2: They live in the country. - Synonyms: nation, rural area - Antonyms: (none) - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים! "my country" = המדינה שלי; "the country" = האזור הכפרי. ### 194. world (n.) - Definition: the planet Earth; all people - תרגום: עולם - Example 1: The world is changing fast. - Example 2: People all over the world celebrate New Year. - Synonyms: earth, globe - 💡 Memory tip: "world" = מצב הדברים + מקום פיזי. ### 195. street (n.) - Definition: a road in a town/city - תרגום: רחוב - Example 1: I live on a quiet street. - Example 2: Cross the street carefully. - Synonyms: road, avenue - 💡 Memory tip: במכתבים: "Main Street". ### 196. road (n.) - Definition: a paved way for vehicles - תרגום: דרך, כביש - Example 1: The road is closed due to construction. - Example 2: We drove along the coastal road. - Synonyms: highway, street - 💡 Memory tip: יותר כללי מ-street (גם בין ערים). ### 197. park (n.) - Definition: a public area with trees and grass - תרגום: פארק, גן ציבורי - Example 1: Let's go for a walk in the park. - Example 2: The park is full of children. - Synonyms: garden,

title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## חלק ג': 100 תארים (Adjectives) מבנה: 100 תארים בסיסיים מחולקים ל-5 קטגוריות תיאור --
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## חלק ג': 100 תארים (Adjectives) מבנה: 100 תארים בסיסיים מחולקים ל-5 קטגוריות תיאור --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. גודל ומידה (351-370) - 20 מילים 2. תכונות אדם (371-395) - 25 מילים 3. רגשות ומצבים (396-415) - 20 מילים 4. זמן וגיל (416-425) - 10 מילים 5. תיאור איכותי (426-450) - 25 מילים --- # 📏 קטגוריה 1: גודל ומידה (20 מילים) ### 351. big (adj.) - Definition: large in size - תרגום: גדול - Example 1: They live in a big house. - Example 2: She has a big smile. - Synonyms: large, huge, enormous - Antonyms: small, little - 💡 Memory tip: bigger, biggest - comparative/superlative. ### 352. small (adj.) - Definition: little in size - תרגום: קטן - Example 1: This is a small room. - Example 2: I have a small dog. - Synonyms: little, tiny - Antonyms: big, large - 💡 Memory tip: smaller, smallest. ### 353. large (adj.) - Definition: big in size - תרגום: גדול (פורמלי יותר) - Example 1: We need a large table. - Example 2: A large crowd gathered. - Synonyms: big, huge - Antonyms: small - 💡 Memory tip: large פורמלי יותר מ-big. ### 354. huge (adj.) - Definition: very big - תרגום: עצום, ענק - Example 1: The elephant is huge. - Example 2: That's a huge problem. - Synonyms: enormous, massive, gigantic - Antonyms: tiny, small - 💡 Memory tip: חזק יותר מ-"big" או "large". ### 355. tiny (adj.) - Definition: extremely small - תרגום: זעיר - Example 1: She has a tiny puppy. - Example 2: Only a tiny amount is needed. - Synonyms: small, little, minute - Antonyms: huge, enormous - 💡 Memory tip: קטן במיוחד. ### 356. tall (adj.) - Definition: of great height - תרגום: גבוה (אדם/עץ) - Example 1: He is very tall. - Example 2: The tall tree gives nice shade. - Synonyms: high - Antonyms: short - 💡 Memory tip: tall לאנשים/עצים. high למקומות/מחיר. ### 357. short (adj.) - Definition: small in height; brief - תרגום: נמוך; קצר - Example 1: She is short. - Example 2: It was a short trip. - Synonyms: little (height); brief (time) - Antonyms: tall; long - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: גובה או משך זמן. ### 358. high (adj.) - Definition: at a great height; significant - תרגום: גבוה (מקום, מחיר) - Example 1: The mountain is very high. - Example 2: The price is too high. - Synonyms: tall, elevated - Antonyms: low - 💡 Memory tip: high למיקום/מחיר; tall לאנשים. ### 359. low (adj.) - Definition: not high; below average - תרגום: נמוך - Example 1: The ceiling is low. - Example 2: Prices are low today. - Synonyms: below (average), little - Antonyms: high - 💡 Memory tip: אנטונים של high. ### 360. long (adj.) - Definition: of great length; lasting a long time - תרגום: ארוך - Example 1: She has long hair. - Example 2: It was a long day. - Synonyms: lengthy - Antonyms: short - 💡 Memory tip: גם פיזי וגם זמני. ### 361. wide (adj.) - Definition: extending far from side to side - תרגום: רחב - Example 1: The road is very wide. - Example 2: She has a wide smile. - Synonyms: broad - Antonyms: narrow - 💡 Memory tip: wide open = פתוח לרווחה. ### 362. narrow (adj.) - Definition: not wide - תרגום: צר - Example 1: The narrow path winds through the forest. - Example 2: The door is too narrow for this furniture. - Synonyms: thin, slim - Antonyms: wide, broad - 💡 Memory tip: Narrow = not wide. ### 363. thick (adj.) - Definition: large in width between opposite surfaces - תרגום: עבה - Example 1: This book is very thick. - Example 2: She has thick hair. - Synonyms: wide, dense - Antonyms: thin - 💡 Memory tip: רעיון של "עובי". ### 364. thin (adj.) - Definition: not thick; slim - תרגום: דק; רזה - Example 1: The paper is too thin. - Example 2: He's tall and thin. - Synonyms: slim, slender - Antonyms: thick, fat - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: דק פיזית / רזה לאדם. ### 365. heavy (adj.) - Definition: weighing a lot - תרגום: כבד - Example 1: This box is heavy. - Example 2: We had a heavy meal. - Synonyms: weighty - Antonyms: light - 💡 Memory tip: גם מטפורי: "heavy traffic", "heavy rain". ### 366. light (adj.) - Definition: not heavy; pale (colors); bright - תרגום: קל; בהיר - Example 1: My bag is very light. - Example 2: She wore a light blue dress. - Synonyms: weightless; pale; bright - Antonyms: heavy; dark - 💡 Memory tip: 3 מובנים: לא כבד / בהיר / מואר. ### 367. full (adj.) - Definition: containing as much as possible - תרגום: מלא - Example 1: The glass is full. - Example 2: I'm full - no more food for me. - Synonyms: filled - Antonyms: empty - 💡 Memory tip: full of X = מלא ב-X. ### 368. empty (adj.) - Definition: containing nothing - תרגום: ריק - Example 1: The room is empty. - Example 2: My wallet is empty. - Synonyms: bare, vacant - Antonyms: full - 💡 Memory tip: empty stomach = קיבה ריקה. ### 369. far (adj./adv.) - Definition: at a great distance - תרגום: רחוק - Example 1: My house is far from here. - Example 2: How far is the airport? - Synonyms: distant - Antonyms: near, close - 💡 Memory tip: Comparative: farther/further. ### 370. near (adj./prep.) - Definition: close in distance - תרגום: קרוב - Example 1: The bank is near my house. - Example 2: The beach is very near. - Synonyms: close - Antonyms: far, distant - 💡 Memory tip: גם מילת יחס: near the door = ליד הדלת. --- # 👤 קטגוריה 2: תכונות אדם (25 מילים) ### 371. good (adj.) - Definition: of high quality; morally right - תרגום: טוב - Example 1: This is a good book. - Example 2: She's a good person. - Synonyms: fine, excellent - Antonyms: bad - 💡 Memory tip: Comparative: better. Superlative: best. ### 372. bad (adj.) - Definition: of low quality; morally wrong - תרגום: רע - Example 1: This is a bad idea. - Example 2: That was a bad decision. - Synonyms: poor, terrible - Antonyms: good - 💡 Memory tip: Comparative: worse. Superlative: worst. ### 373. nice (adj.) - Definition: pleasant; kind - תרגום: נחמד - Example 1: What a nice day! - Example 2: He's a nice guy. - Synonyms: pleasant, friendly, kind - Antonyms: mean, unpleasant - 💡 Memory tip: Nice to meet you = נעים להכיר. ### 374. kind (adj.) - Definition: friendly and generous - תרגום: נחמד, אדיב - Example 1: Thank you, that's very kind. - Example 2: She's a kind teacher. - Synonyms: nice, generous, friendly - Antonyms: mean, cruel - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם - "what kind?" = "איזה סוג?". ### 375. mean (adj.) - Definition: unkind; not generous - תרגום: אכזרי, רשעי - Example 1: Don't be mean to your sister. - Example 2: He said a mean thing. - Synonyms: cruel, unkind - Antonyms: kind, nice - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל (להתכוון). ### 376. friendly (adj.) - Definition: warm and kind - תרגום: ידידותי - Example 1: The dog is very friendly. - Example 2: Our neighbors are friendly. - Synonyms: nice, kind, warm - Antonyms: unfriendly, hostile - 💡 Memory tip: friend + -ly. ### 377. smart (adj.) - Definition: intelligent; clever - תרגום: חכם - Example 1: She's very smart. - Example 2: That was a smart decision. - Synonyms: intelligent, clever - Antonyms: stupid, dumb - 💡 Memory tip: אמריקאי - מאוד נפוץ. בבריטית: clever. ### 378. clever (adj.) - Definition: quick to understand - תרגום: פיקח - Example 1: What a clever idea! - Example 2: She's a clever student. - Synonyms: smart, intelligent - Antonyms: stupid - 💡 Memory tip: בריטי - נפוץ יותר. ### 379. stupid (adj.) - Definition: not intelligent - תרגום: טיפש - Example 1: That was a stupid mistake. - Example 2: Don't be stupid. - Synonyms: dumb, foolish - Antonyms: smart, clever - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי - היזהר בשימוש! ### 380. funny (adj.) - Definition: causing laughter; strange - תרגום: מצחיק; מוזר - Example 1: That joke was so funny! - Example 2: It's funny, I thought I heard something. - Synonyms: amusing, strange - Antonyms: boring, serious - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים! funny ha-ha = מצחיק; funny peculiar = מוזר. ### 381. serious (adj.) - Definition: important; not joking - תרגום: רציני - Example 1: This is a serious problem. - Example 2: Are you serious? - Synonyms: grave, important - Antonyms: funny, silly - 💡 Memory tip: seriously (adverb) = ברצינות. ### 382. honest (adj.) - Definition: truthful - תרגום: ישר, הגון - Example 1: Be honest with me. - Example 2: He's an honest person. - Synonyms: truthful, sincere - Antonyms: dishonest, lying - 💡 Memory tip: "h" silent! /ˈɒnɪst/. ### 383. brave (adj.) - Definition: showing courage - תרגום: אמיץ - Example 1: He's a brave soldier. - Example 2: It took a brave heart to speak up. - Synonyms: courageous, bold - Antonyms: cowardly, fearful - 💡 Memory tip: "bravery" = אומץ (noun). ### 384. polite (adj.) - Definition: showing good manners - תרגום: מנומס - Example 1: She's always polite. - Example 2: Be polite to the guests. - Synonyms: well-mannered, respectful - Antonyms: rude, impolite - 💡 Memory tip: politeness = נימוס. ### 385. rude (adj.) - Definition: not polite - תרגום: גס, לא מנומס - Example 1: Don't be rude. - Example 2: That was a rude question. - Synonyms: impolite, disrespectful - Antonyms: polite, kind - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי - היזהר. ### 386. quiet (adj.) - Definition: not loud; silent - תרגום: שקט - Example 1: Please be quiet. - Example 2: She's a quiet person. - Synonyms: silent, calm - Antonyms: loud, noisy - 💡 Memory tip: quiet ≠ quite (די)! איות קרוב אך שונה. ### 387. loud (adj.) - Definition: making much noise - תרגום: רועש - Example 1: The music is too loud. - Example 2: She has a loud voice. - Synonyms: noisy - Antonyms: quiet, soft - 💡 Memory tip: loudly (adverb). ### 388. busy (adj.) - Definition: having much to do - תרגום: עסוק - Example 1: I'm very busy today. - Example 2: The streets are busy. - Synonyms: occupied, engaged - Antonyms: free, idle - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: /ˈbɪzi/ (ה-u נשמעת כ-i!). ### 389. free (adj.) - Definition: not occupied; costing nothing; liberated - תרגום: חופשי; חינם - Example 1: I'm free tomorrow. - Example 2: This is free. - Synonyms: available, unengaged - Antonyms: busy, expensive - 💡 Memory tip: 3 מובנים: זמן פנוי, חינם, חופשי. ### 390. tired (adj.) - Definition: in need of rest - תרגום: עייף - Example 1: I'm so tired today. - Example 2: She looks tired. - Synonyms: exhausted, weary - Antonyms: energetic, fresh - 💡 Memory tip: מ-"tire" (עייפות). ### 391. healthy (adj.) - Definition: in good health - תרגום: בריא - Example 1: A healthy diet is important. - Example 2: She's a healthy young woman. - Synonyms: fit, well - Antonyms: sick, ill - 💡 Memory tip: מ-"health". ### 392. sick (adj.) / ill - Definition: not feeling well - תרגום: חולה - Example 1: I'm sick today. - Example 2: She was ill last week. - Synonyms: ill, unwell - Antonyms: healthy, well - 💡 Memory tip: sick - אמריקאי נפוץ. ill - בריטי / רשמי יותר. ### 393. young (adj.) - Definition: in the early stage of life - תרגום: צעיר - Example 1: She's still young. - Example 2: The young children played outside. - Synonyms: youthful - Antonyms: old - 💡 Memory tip: younger, youngest. ### 394. strong (adj.) - Definition: having physical power; lasting - תרגום: חזק - Example 1: He's strong enough to lift that. - Example 2: She has a strong personality. - Synonyms: powerful, tough - Antonyms: weak - 💡 Memory tip: גם פיזי וגם מטפורי. ### 395. weak (adj.) - Definition: lacking strength - תרגום: חלש - Example 1: I feel weak after the flu. - Example 2: That was a weak argument. - Synonyms: feeble, frail - Antonyms: strong - 💡 Memory tip: זהירות: weak ≠ week (שבוע)! --- # 😊 קטגוריה 3: רגשות ומצבים (20 מילים) ### 396. happy (adj.) - Definition: feeling pleased - תרגום: שמח - Example 1: I'm happy to see you. - Example 2: She has a happy smile. - Synonyms: joyful, glad, pleased - Antonyms: sad, unhappy - 💡 Memory tip: happier, happiest. ### 397. sad (adj.) - Definition: feeling sorrow - תרגום: עצוב - Example 1: Why are you so sad? - Example 2: That's a sad story. - Synonyms: unhappy, upset - Antonyms: happy - 💡 Memory tip: sadness (noun). ### 398. angry (adj.) - Definition: feeling strong displeasure - תרגום: כועס - Example 1: He's angry with me. - Example 2: Don't be angry, I'm sorry. - Synonyms: mad, furious - Antonyms: calm, pleased - 💡 Memory tip: angrier, angriest. ### 399. excited (adj.) - Definition: fe

title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## חלק ד': 50 תארי פועל ומילות חיבור (Adverbs & Connectives) מבנה: 50 מילים מחולקות ל-4
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #1 – רמת Easy ## חלק ד': 50 תארי פועל ומילות חיבור (Adverbs & Connectives) מבנה: 50 מילים מחולקות ל-4 קטגוריות --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. תארי פועל של אופן ודרך (451-465) - 15 מילים 2. תארי פועל של זמן ותדירות (466-480) - 15 מילים 3. מילות קישור (Connectives) (481-495) - 15 מילים 4. ביטויים חשובים (496-500) - 5 מילים --- # 🏃 קטגוריה 1: תארי פועל של אופן ודרך (15 מילים) ### 451. quickly (adv.) - Definition: at a fast speed - תרגום: במהירות - Example 1: She quickly finished her work. - Example 2: The children ran quickly. - Synonyms: fast, rapidly, swiftly - Antonyms: slowly - 💡 Memory tip: מ-"quick" + -ly. ### 452. slowly (adv.) - Definition: at a slow speed - תרגום: לאט - Example 1: Please speak slowly. - Example 2: The train moved slowly. - Synonyms: gradually - Antonyms: quickly, fast - 💡 Memory tip: מ-"slow" + -ly. ### 453. carefully (adv.) - Definition: with attention and care - תרגום: בזהירות - Example 1: Read the instructions carefully. - Example 2: She drives carefully. - Synonyms: cautiously, attentively - Antonyms: carelessly - 💡 Memory tip: carefully = "full of care". ### 454. easily (adv.) - Definition: without difficulty - תרגום: בקלות - Example 1: She solved the problem easily. - Example 2: He can easily lift 100 kilograms. - Synonyms: effortlessly, simply - Antonyms: with difficulty - 💡 Memory tip: easy → easily. ### 455. badly (adv.) - Definition: in a bad way; very much - תרגום: בצורה גרועה; מאוד - Example 1: He plays football badly. - Example 2: I badly need a vacation. - Synonyms: poorly - Antonyms: well - 💡 Memory tip: שני שימושים: איכות גרועה / הדגשה חזקה. ### 456. well (adv.) - Definition: in a good way; correctly - תרגום: היטב - Example 1: She speaks English well. - Example 2: Did you sleep well? - Synonyms: properly, effectively - Antonyms: badly, poorly - 💡 Memory tip: חריג! good (adj) → well (adv), לא "goodly". ### 457. hard (adv.) - Definition: with great effort - תרגום: קשה (במאמץ) - Example 1: She works hard. - Example 2: Try hard and you'll succeed. - Synonyms: with effort, vigorously - Antonyms: easily - 💡 Memory tip: "hard" עצמו הוא adv! לא "hardly". ### 458. hardly (adv.) - Definition: almost not; barely - תרגום: כמעט ולא, בקושי - Example 1: I hardly know him. - Example 2: She hardly eats anything. - Synonyms: barely, scarcely - Antonyms: frequently - 💡 Memory tip: חשוב! hard = קשה. hardly = כמעט ולא. שונים לגמרי! ### 459. almost (adv.) - Definition: very nearly - תרגום: כמעט - Example 1: I'm almost finished. - Example 2: It's almost 5 o'clock. - Synonyms: nearly - Antonyms: exactly - 💡 Memory tip: almost = almost there (כמעט שם). ### 460. nearly (adv.) - Definition: almost - תרגום: כמעט - Example 1: I nearly fell. - Example 2: She's nearly 18 years old. - Synonyms: almost - Antonyms: completely, exactly - 💡 Memory tip: almost ו-nearly = כמעט זהים. ### 461. completely (adv.) - Definition: entirely; totally - תרגום: לגמרי - Example 1: I completely agree with you. - Example 2: The work is completely finished. - Synonyms: totally, fully, entirely - Antonyms: partially - 💡 Memory tip: complete + -ly. ### 462. totally (adv.) - Definition: completely - תרגום: לגמרי, בסך הכל - Example 1: I totally forgot about the meeting. - Example 2: That's totally fine. - Synonyms: completely, entirely - Antonyms: partially - 💡 Memory tip: גם casual: "totally!" = "לגמרי!". ### 463. really (adv.) - Definition: very; actually - תרגום: באמת, מאוד - Example 1: I'm really tired. - Example 2: Is that really true? - Synonyms: very, actually, truly - Antonyms: slightly - 💡 Memory tip: תואר פועל נפוץ מאוד בדיבור יומיומי. ### 464. very (adv.) - Definition: to a high degree - תרגום: מאוד - Example 1: This is very important. - Example 2: She's very happy today. - Synonyms: extremely, really - Antonyms: slightly - 💡 Memory tip: לא להשתמש לפני comparatives ("very bigger" = שגוי!). ### 465. too (adv.) - Definition: more than needed; also - תרגום: יותר מדי; גם - Example 1: It's too hot to play outside. - Example 2: I want to come too. - Synonyms: excessively; also - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים! "too hot" = חם מדי. "me too" = אני גם. --- # ⏱️ קטגוריה 2: תארי פועל של זמן ותדירות (15 מילים) ### 466. always (adv.) - Definition: at all times - תרגום: תמיד - Example 1: She always arrives on time. - Example 2: I will always remember this day. - Synonyms: constantly, forever - Antonyms: never - 💡 Memory tip: 100% - הכי גבוה בתדירות. ### 467. usually (adv.) - Definition: most of the time - תרגום: בדרך כלל - Example 1: I usually take the bus to work. - Example 2: She usually drinks coffee in the morning. - Synonyms: generally, normally - Antonyms: rarely - 💡 Memory tip: כ-90% מהזמן. ### 468. often (adv.) - Definition: many times - תרגום: לעתים קרובות - Example 1: We often go to the beach. - Example 2: How often do you exercise? - Synonyms: frequently - Antonyms: rarely, seldom - 💡 Memory tip: כ-70% מהזמן. הגייה: /ˈɒfən/ (t שקטה). ### 469. sometimes (adv.) - Definition: occasionally - תרגום: לפעמים - Example 1: Sometimes I walk to work. - Example 2: She sometimes calls her mother. - Synonyms: occasionally, at times - Antonyms: always; never - 💡 Memory tip: כ-50% מהזמן. ### 470. rarely (adv.) - Definition: not often - תרגום: נדיר - Example 1: I rarely eat junk food. - Example 2: He rarely talks to strangers. - Synonyms: seldom, hardly ever - Antonyms: often, frequently - 💡 Memory tip: כ-10% מהזמן. ### 471. never (adv.) - Definition: not at any time - תרגום: אף פעם לא - Example 1: I never eat sushi. - Example 2: She has never been to Europe. - Synonyms: not ever - Antonyms: always - 💡 Memory tip: 0% - ההפך מ-always. ### 472. now (adv.) - Definition: at this moment - תרגום: עכשיו - Example 1: I'm busy right now. - Example 2: We need to leave now. - Synonyms: currently, at present - Antonyms: then, later - 💡 Memory tip: הרגע הנוכחי. ### 473. then (adv.) - Definition: at that time; next - תרגום: אז; אחר כך - Example 1: We ate, then we went to the movie. - Example 2: Back then, we didn't have phones. - Synonyms: next, afterward - Antonyms: now - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: "אז" (אז בעבר) / "אחר כך" (ברצף פעולות). ### 474. soon (adv.) - Definition: in a short time - תרגום: בקרוב - Example 1: I'll be there soon. - Example 2: She's coming home soon. - Synonyms: shortly - Antonyms: later, not yet - 💡 Memory tip: see you soon = נתראה בקרוב. ### 475. later (adv.) - Definition: after the present time - תרגום: מאוחר יותר - Example 1: I'll call you later. - Example 2: See you later! - Synonyms: afterward, subsequently - Antonyms: earlier, now - 💡 Memory tip: late + -er = יותר מאוחר. ### 476. already (adv.) - Definition: before now; sooner than expected - תרגום: כבר - Example 1: I've already finished my homework. - Example 2: She's already gone home. - Synonyms: previously, by now - Antonyms: not yet - 💡 Memory tip: מופיע עם Present Perfect: "have already V3". ### 477. yet (adv.) - Definition: up until now (in questions/negatives) - תרגום: עדיין - Example 1: Have you finished yet? - Example 2: I haven't seen that movie yet. - Synonyms: still, until now - 💡 Memory tip: yet - בשאלות ובשלילה; already - בחיובי. ### 478. still (adv.) - Definition: up to this time; yet continuing - תרגום: עדיין - Example 1: She's still waiting for her friend. - Example 2: Are you still hungry? - Synonyms: yet, continuously - 💡 Memory tip: גם תואר (still = שקט/יציב). ### 479. just (adv.) - Definition: very recently; only; exactly - תרגום: רק עכשיו; פשוט - Example 1: I just arrived. - Example 2: I just want to sleep. - Synonyms: recently; simply - 💡 Memory tip: מילה רבת-משמעויות. לרוב מתייחסת לזמן קרוב. ### 480. once (adv.) - Definition: one time - תרגום: פעם אחת - Example 1: I visited Paris once. - Example 2: She calls her grandmother once a week. - Synonyms: one time - Antonyms: never; many times - 💡 Memory tip: גם: once upon a time = היה היה (תחילת אגדה). --- # 🔗 קטגוריה 3: מילות קישור (Connectives) (15 מילים) ### 481. and (conj.) - Definition: connects similar ideas - תרגום: ו-, וגם - Example 1: Tom and I went to the store. - Example 2: She smiled and waved. - Synonyms: also, plus - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור הבסיסית ביותר - חיבור. ### 482. but (conj.) - Definition: connects contrasting ideas - תרגום: אבל - Example 1: I want to go, but I'm tired. - Example 2: She's smart but shy. - Synonyms: however, yet - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של ניגוד. ### 483. or (conj.) - Definition: presents alternatives - תרגום: או - Example 1: Would you like tea or coffee? - Example 2: We can go by car or bus. - Synonyms: either...or - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של בחירה. ### 484. so (conj./adv.) - Definition: for this reason; therefore - תרגום: לכן, אז - Example 1: It was raining, so we stayed home. - Example 2: I was tired, so I went to bed. - Synonyms: therefore, thus - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של תוצאה. ### 485. because (conj.) - Definition: for the reason that - תרגום: כי, בגלל ש- - Example 1: I'm happy because I passed the test. - Example 2: She's late because of traffic. - Synonyms: since, as - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של סיבה. ### 486. if (conj.) - Definition: in the event that - תרגום: אם - Example 1: If it rains, we'll stay inside. - Example 2: I'll help you if you need it. - Synonyms: in case, provided that - 💡 Memory tip: מילת הקישור של תנאי. ### 487. when (conj./adv.) - Definition: at what time; at the time that - תרגום: מתי; כאשר - Example 1: When do you finish work? - Example 2: Call me when you arrive. - Synonyms: at the time that - 💡 Memory tip: גם לשאלות (מתי?) וגם לקישור. ### 488. while (conj.) - Definition: during the time that - תרגום: בזמן ש-, כאשר - Example 1: I read while I waited. - Example 2: While she cooked, he cleaned. - Synonyms: during, as - 💡 Memory tip: שתי פעולות בו-זמנית. ### 489. before (prep./conj.) - Definition: at an earlier time than - תרגום: לפני - Example 1: Before we leave, let's eat. - Example 2: He arrived before noon. - Synonyms: earlier than, prior to - Antonyms: after - 💡 Memory tip: במילון של זמן: before. ### 490. after (prep./conj.) - Definition: at a later time than - תרגום: אחרי - Example 1: After dinner, we watched TV. - Example 2: I'll call you after I finish. - Synonyms: following, later than - Antonyms: before - 💡 Memory tip: אחרי (זמן / מיקום ברצף). ### 491. although (conj.) - Definition: in spite of; even though - תרגום: למרות ש- - Example 1: Although it was cold, we went hiking. - Example 2: She smiled although she was sad. - Synonyms: even though, despite the fact that - 💡 Memory tip: מילה פורמלית ל-"but"; יוצרת ניגוד. ### 492. however (adv.) - Definition: on the other hand - תרגום: עם זאת, אולם - Example 1: The plan is good. However, it's expensive. - Example 2: I wanted to go; however, I was too tired. - Synonyms: nevertheless, but - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-"but". משמש בתחילת משפט עם פסיק. ### 493. also (adv.) - Definition: in addition; too - תרגום: גם - Example 1: She's smart and also kind. - Example 2: I also want to come. - Synonyms: too, as well - 💡 Memory tip: also באמצע משפט; too בסוף. ### 494. both (det./pron.) - Definition: the two together - תרגום: שניהם - Example 1: Both of us are tired. - Example 2: I like both cats and dogs. - Synonyms: the two - Antonyms: neither - 💡 Memory tip: both X and Y = גם X וגם Y. ### 495. only (adv.) - Definition: nothing else; just - תרגום: רק - Example 1: I have only 10 minutes. - Example 2: Only John can help us. - Synonyms: just, merely - 💡 Memory tip: מגביל (limit). --- # 💎 קטגוריה 4: ביטויים חשובים (5 מילים) ### 496. yes (adv.) - Definition: a positive answer - תרגום: כן - Example 1: "Do you like it?" "Yes, I do." - Example 2: Yes, please! - Synonyms: yeah (casual), yep (very casual) - Antonyms: no - 💡 Memory tip: מילת האישור הבסיסית. ### 497. no (adv.) - Definition: a negative answer - תרגום: לא - Example 1: "Are you hungry?" "No, thanks." - Example 2: No, I disagree. - Synonyms: nope (casual) - Antonyms: yes - 💡 Memory tip: מילת השלילה הבסיסית. ### 498. maybe (adv.) - Definition:

title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #2 – רמת Intermediate ## חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) - רמה בינונית מבנה: פעלים ברמה אקדמית בינונית - מש
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #2 – רמת Intermediate ## חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) - רמה בינונית מבנה: פעלים ברמה אקדמית בינונית - משמשים בטקסטים אינטלקטואליים ובמאמרים --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. פעלי פעולה מתקדמים (501-530) - 30 מילים 2. פעלי מחשבה ואנליזה (531-560) - 30 מילים 3. פעלי תקשורת פורמלית (561-590) - 30 מילים 4. פעלי שינוי והתפתחות (591-620) - 30 מילים 5. פעלים אקדמיים (621-650) - 30 מילים --- # 🏃 קטגוריה 1: פעלי פעולה מתקדמים (30 מילים) ### 501. achieve (v.) - Definition: to successfully reach a goal - תרגום: להשיג - Example 1: She worked hard to achieve her dream. - Example 2: The team achieved great results. - Synonyms: accomplish, attain - Antonyms: fail, miss - 💡 Memory tip: Collocation: achieve a goal/success/victory. ### 502. accomplish (v.) - Definition: to complete successfully - תרגום: להשיג, להשלים - Example 1: We accomplished all our tasks today. - Example 2: He accomplished a lot in his career. - Synonyms: achieve, complete - Antonyms: fail - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-achieve. ### 503. acquire (v.) - Definition: to gain or obtain - תרגום: לרכוש, להשיג - Example 1: The company acquired a new office. - Example 2: Children acquire language naturally. - Synonyms: obtain, gain - Antonyms: lose - 💡 Memory tip: Collocation: acquire skills/knowledge. ### 504. obtain (v.) - Definition: to get something, often with effort - תרגום: להשיג, לקבל - Example 1: You need to obtain permission first. - Example 2: She obtained a degree in law. - Synonyms: acquire, get - Antonyms: lose - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-get. ### 505. gain (v.) - Definition: to get something useful - תרגום: לרכוש, להרוויח - Example 1: Exercise helps you gain strength. - Example 2: He gained valuable experience. - Synonyms: acquire, obtain - Antonyms: lose - 💡 Memory tip: gain weight/experience/knowledge. ### 506. provide (v.) - Definition: to give something needed - תרגום: לספק, לתת - Example 1: The school provides free lunch. - Example 2: Can you provide more information? - Synonyms: supply, give, offer - Antonyms: deny, withhold - 💡 Memory tip: provide X for/with Y. ### 507. supply (v.) - Definition: to provide what is needed - תרגום: לספק - Example 1: The company supplies parts to factories. - Example 2: They supply us with everything we need. - Synonyms: provide, give - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "supply and demand". ### 508. deliver (v.) - Definition: to bring something to a place - תרגום: לספק, להעביר - Example 1: We deliver pizza to your door. - Example 2: She delivered a great speech. - Synonyms: bring, transport, give - 💡 Memory tip: deliver a speech/presentation/package. ### 509. transport (v.) - Definition: to carry from one place to another - תרגום: להעביר, להוביל - Example 1: Trains transport passengers daily. - Example 2: The ship transports goods overseas. - Synonyms: carry, move, deliver - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: public transport. ### 510. produce (v.) - Definition: to make or create - תרגום: לייצר, לייצר - Example 1: This factory produces cars. - Example 2: The plant produces fruit every year. - Synonyms: make, create, manufacture - Antonyms: destroy - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: פועל /prəˈduːs/, שם עצם /ˈprɒdjuːs/. ### 511. create (v.) - Definition: to make something new - תרגום: ליצור - Example 1: She created a beautiful painting. - Example 2: We need to create a solution. - Synonyms: make, produce, build - Antonyms: destroy - 💡 Memory tip: create = יצירה מחדש; produce = ייצור כמותי. ### 512. design (v.) - Definition: to plan the look of something - תרגום: לעצב, לתכנן - Example 1: She designed the new logo. - Example 2: The architect designed the building. - Synonyms: plan, create - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "a beautiful design". ### 513. develop (v.) - Definition: to grow or improve - תרגום: לפתח - Example 1: Children develop quickly. - Example 2: The company developed a new product. - Synonyms: grow, create, advance - 💡 Memory tip: develop skills/products/relationships. ### 514. improve (v.) - Definition: to make or become better - תרגום: לשפר - Example 1: Practice helps you improve. - Example 2: We need to improve our performance. - Synonyms: enhance, better, upgrade - Antonyms: worsen - 💡 Memory tip: Collocation: improve skills/quality/performance. ### 515. enhance (v.) - Definition: to improve the quality of - תרגום: לשפר, להעצים - Example 1: The software enhances the image. - Example 2: Music can enhance your mood. - Synonyms: improve, boost - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-improve. ### 516. encourage (v.) - Definition: to give support and confidence - תרגום: לעודד - Example 1: My parents encouraged me to study. - Example 2: The teacher encourages creativity. - Synonyms: support, motivate - Antonyms: discourage - 💡 Memory tip: encourage someone to V. ### 517. discourage (v.) - Definition: to make someone less confident - תרגום: להרתיע - Example 1: Don't let failure discourage you. - Example 2: The bad weather discouraged them. - Synonyms: deter, dishearten - Antonyms: encourage - 💡 Memory tip: dis- = הפוך של encourage. ### 518. recommend (v.) - Definition: to suggest something as good - תרגום: להמליץ - Example 1: I recommend this book. - Example 2: The doctor recommended rest. - Synonyms: suggest, advise - 💡 Memory tip: recommend + V-ing או recommend that + subjunctive. ### 519. suggest (v.) - Definition: to propose an idea - תרגום: להציע, לרמוז - Example 1: I suggest we leave early. - Example 2: The evidence suggests he's innocent. - Synonyms: propose, recommend, imply - 💡 Memory tip: גם "לרמוז": evidence suggests. ### 520. propose (v.) - Definition: to put forward an idea - תרגום: להציע - Example 1: She proposed a new plan. - Example 2: He proposed marriage to her. - Synonyms: suggest, offer - 💡 Memory tip: יותר פורמלי מ-suggest. גם: להציע נישואין. ### 521. offer (v.) - Definition: to present for acceptance - תרגום: להציע - Example 1: They offered me a job. - Example 2: Can I offer you some coffee? - Synonyms: provide, present - Antonyms: refuse - 💡 Memory tip: offer X to Y / offer to V. ### 522. refuse (v.) - Definition: to say no to something - תרגום: לסרב - Example 1: He refused to help me. - Example 2: She refused the invitation. - Synonyms: decline, reject - Antonyms: accept, agree - 💡 Memory tip: refuse to V = לסרב לעשות. ### 523. reject (v.) - Definition: to not accept - תרגום: לדחות - Example 1: The committee rejected the proposal. - Example 2: She rejected the offer. - Synonyms: refuse, decline, turn down - Antonyms: accept, approve - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-refuse; בהקשר החלטות. ### 524. approve (v.) - Definition: to accept as good; to give permission - תרגום: לאשר - Example 1: The boss approved the project. - Example 2: I don't approve of smoking. - Synonyms: accept, sanction - Antonyms: reject, disapprove - 💡 Memory tip: approve of X = לאשר/לחזק X. ### 525. request (v.) - Definition: to ask politely for - תרגום: לבקש - Example 1: She requested a glass of water. - Example 2: I request your attention. - Synonyms: ask, seek - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-ask. ### 526. demand (v.) - Definition: to ask forcefully - תרגום: לדרוש - Example 1: Workers demanded higher pay. - Example 2: The situation demands attention. - Synonyms: require, insist on - 💡 Memory tip: חזק יותר מ-request או ask. ### 527. require (v.) - Definition: to need - תרגום: לדרוש, להזדקק - Example 1: This job requires experience. - Example 2: Plants require water to grow. - Synonyms: need, demand - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-need. ### 528. prevent (v.) - Definition: to stop something from happening - תרגום: למנוע - Example 1: Exercise prevents disease. - Example 2: Rain prevented the game. - Synonyms: stop, block, avoid - Antonyms: allow, enable - 💡 Memory tip: prevent someone from V-ing. ### 529. cause (v.) - Definition: to make something happen - תרגום: לגרום - Example 1: Smoking causes cancer. - Example 2: The storm caused damage. - Synonyms: produce, result in - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "cause and effect". ### 530. affect (v.) - Definition: to have an effect on - תרגום: להשפיע על - Example 1: The news affected everyone. - Example 2: Stress affects your health. - Synonyms: influence, impact - 💡 Memory tip: affect (פועל) ≠ effect (שם עצם)! --- # 🧠 קטגוריה 2: פעלי מחשבה ואנליזה (30 מילים) ### 531. analyze (v.) - Definition: to examine in detail - תרגום: לנתח - Example 1: Scientists analyze data carefully. - Example 2: She analyzed the problem logically. - Synonyms: examine, study, investigate - 💡 Memory tip: גם analyse (בריטי). ### 532. examine (v.) - Definition: to inspect carefully - תרגום: לבדוק, לחקור - Example 1: The doctor examined the patient. - Example 2: Let's examine the evidence. - Synonyms: inspect, analyze, check - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-check. ### 533. investigate (v.) - Definition: to research carefully - תרגום: לחקור - Example 1: The police are investigating the crime. - Example 2: We need to investigate the cause. - Synonyms: research, examine, probe - 💡 Memory tip: קשור למשטרה ולחקירות מדעיות. ### 534. research (v.) - Definition: to study carefully - תרגום: לחקור - Example 1: I researched the topic for days. - Example 2: Scientists research new medicines. - Synonyms: study, investigate - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "scientific research". ### 535. observe (v.) - Definition: to watch carefully - תרגום: להתבונן, לצפות - Example 1: The children observed the butterflies. - Example 2: I observed a change in behavior. - Synonyms: watch, notice, witness - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-watch. ### 536. notice (v.) - Definition: to become aware of - תרגום: לשים לב - Example 1: Did you notice her new haircut? - Example 2: I noticed something strange. - Synonyms: observe, see, spot - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: "a notice on the board". ### 537. realize (v.) - Definition: to become aware of; to make real - תרגום: להבין, לקלוט; להגשים - Example 1: I realized my mistake too late. - Example 2: She realized her dream. - Synonyms: understand, recognize; achieve - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים. הבריטי: realise. ### 538. recognize (v.) - Definition: to identify something known - תרגום: לזהות, להכיר - Example 1: I didn't recognize her with short hair. - Example 2: The school recognizes hard work. - Synonyms: identify, know - 💡 Memory tip: re- + -cognize (לדעת שוב). ### 539. identify (v.) - Definition: to establish the identity of - תרגום: לזהות - Example 1: Can you identify the suspect? - Example 2: We need to identify the problem. - Synonyms: recognize, determine - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-recognize. ### 540. determine (v.) - Definition: to decide or find out - תרגום: לקבוע, להחליט - Example 1: We need to determine the cause. - Example 2: She determined to succeed. - Synonyms: decide, establish - 💡 Memory tip: קשור ל-determination (נחישות). ### 541. consider (v.) - Definition: to think about carefully - תרגום: לשקול, לחשוב על - Example 1: Consider all your options. - Example 2: I consider him a friend. - Synonyms: think about, regard - 💡 Memory tip: consider + V-ing = שוקל לעשות. ### 542. assume (v.) - Definition: to believe without proof - תרגום: להניח - Example 1: I assume you're coming. - Example 2: Don't assume - ask! - Synonyms: presume, suppose - Antonyms: know, verify - 💡 Memory tip: הנחה ללא הוכחה. ### 543. suppose (v.) - Definition: to think likely; to assume - תרגום: להניח, לחשוב - Example 1: I suppose you're right. - Example 2: Suppose it rains, what will we do? - Synonyms: assume, think - 💡 Memory tip: I suppose so = אני מניח שכן. ### 544. doubt (v.) - Definition: to feel uncertain about - תרגום: להטיל ספק - Example 1: I doubt she'll come. - Example 2: He never doubted her honesty. - Synonyms: question, suspect - Antonyms: trust, believe - 💡 Memory tip: "b" silent! pronunciation: /daʊt/. ### 545. question (v.) - Definition: to ask about; to doubt - תרגום: לשאול; להטיל ספק - Example 1: The police questioned the witness. - Example 2: I question his motives. - Synonyms: ask, doubt - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם - שאלה. ### 546. compare (v.) - Definition: to examine simi

title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #2 – רמת Intermediate ## חלק ב': 200 שמות עצם (Nouns) - רמה בינונית מבנה: 200 שמות עצם ברמת Intermedi
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #2 – רמת Intermediate ## חלק ב': 200 שמות עצם (Nouns) - רמה בינונית מבנה: 200 שמות עצם ברמת Intermediate - מושגים אקדמיים, אישיים, ומופשטים --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. מושגים חברתיים ופוליטיים (651-690) - 40 מילים 2. עולם העבודה והמקצועות (691-730) - 40 מילים 3. חינוך ולמידה (731-770) - 40 מילים 4. רגשות ומצבים נפשיים (771-800) - 30 מילים 5. מדע וטכנולוגיה (801-830) - 30 מילים 6. אמנות ותרבות (831-850) - 20 מילים --- # 🏛️ קטגוריה 1: מושגים חברתיים ופוליטיים (40 מילים) ### 651. society (n.) - Definition: a community of people - תרגום: חברה (אנושית) - Example 1: Society is changing rapidly. - Example 2: He contributes to society. - Synonyms: community, public - 💡 Memory tip: social (adj) → society (n). ### 652. community (n.) - Definition: a group of people sharing something - תרגום: קהילה - Example 1: Our community is very diverse. - Example 2: The local community protested. - Synonyms: group, neighborhood - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: communities. ### 653. government (n.) - Definition: the system ruling a country - תרגום: ממשלה - Example 1: The government announced new policies. - Example 2: Every country needs a government. - Synonyms: administration, authorities - 💡 Memory tip: מ-govern (למשול). ### 654. politics (n.) - Definition: activities of government - תרגום: פוליטיקה - Example 1: I don't follow politics. - Example 2: Politics is complicated. - Synonyms: government affairs - 💡 Memory tip: politics יחיד אף שנגמר ב-s. ### 655. law (n.) - Definition: a system of rules - תרגום: חוק - Example 1: Breaking the law has consequences. - Example 2: She studies law. - Synonyms: rule, legislation - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: laws. ### 656. rule (n.) - Definition: an instruction about what to do - תרגום: כלל, חוק - Example 1: Follow the rules of the game. - Example 2: There's a rule against smoking here. - Synonyms: regulation, law - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: to rule = למשול. ### 657. justice (n.) - Definition: fairness; the legal system - תרגום: צדק - Example 1: We demand justice for the victim. - Example 2: The justice system must work fairly. - Synonyms: fairness, righteousness - Antonyms: injustice - 💡 Memory tip: just (adj) = צודק. ### 658. right (n.) - Definition: a moral or legal entitlement - תרגום: זכות - Example 1: Everyone has the right to free speech. - Example 2: Women's rights are human rights. - Synonyms: entitlement, privilege - 💡 Memory tip: הרבה מובנים - גם "ימין", גם "נכון". ### 659. freedom (n.) - Definition: the state of being free - תרגום: חופש, חירות - Example 1: Freedom is a basic right. - Example 2: I cherish my freedom. - Synonyms: liberty, independence - Antonyms: slavery, oppression - 💡 Memory tip: מ-free + -dom. ### 660. election (n.) - Definition: a formal vote - תרגום: בחירות - Example 1: The election is next month. - Example 2: She won the election. - Synonyms: vote, ballot - 💡 Memory tip: elect (פועל) → election (ש"ע). ### 661. vote (n.) - Definition: a formal expression of choice - תרגום: הצבעה, קול - Example 1: Every vote counts. - Example 2: She cast her vote early. - Synonyms: ballot, choice - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: to vote = להצביע. ### 662. democracy (n.) - Definition: government by the people - תרגום: דמוקרטיה - Example 1: Israel is a democracy. - Example 2: Democracy protects freedoms. - Synonyms: (none) - Antonyms: dictatorship - 💡 Memory tip: demo (אנשים) + -cracy (שלטון). ### 663. policy (n.) - Definition: a plan of action - תרגום: מדיניות - Example 1: The company's policy is fair. - Example 2: Immigration policy is changing. - Synonyms: plan, strategy - 💡 Memory tip: policies (plural). ### 664. leader (n.) - Definition: a person who guides others - תרגום: מנהיג - Example 1: A good leader inspires others. - Example 2: She became the leader of the group. - Synonyms: chief, head - Antonyms: follower - 💡 Memory tip: lead + -er. ### 665. leadership (n.) - Definition: the ability to lead - תרגום: מנהיגות - Example 1: Her leadership saved the company. - Example 2: Leadership requires courage. - Synonyms: guidance, direction - 💡 Memory tip: leader + -ship = התכונה. ### 666. power (n.) - Definition: authority; strength; electricity - תרגום: כוח, שלטון - Example 1: He abuses his power. - Example 2: The power went out. - Synonyms: authority, strength - 💡 Memory tip: הרבה מובנים! תלוי בהקשר. ### 667. authority (n.) - Definition: the power to make decisions - תרגום: סמכות, רשות - Example 1: She has the authority to approve this. - Example 2: The authorities are investigating. - Synonyms: power, command - 💡 Memory tip: "Authorities" = רשויות (המשטרה, השלטון). ### 668. influence (n.) - Definition: the power to affect - תרגום: השפעה - Example 1: Social media has a big influence. - Example 2: His influence is growing. - Synonyms: effect, impact - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל. ### 669. impact (n.) - Definition: a powerful effect - תרגום: השפעה, השלכה - Example 1: Climate change has a huge impact. - Example 2: Her speech had a great impact. - Synonyms: effect, influence - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי ואקדמי. ### 670. effect (n.) - Definition: a result - תרגום: השפעה, תוצאה - Example 1: The medicine had no effect. - Example 2: Side effects include headaches. - Synonyms: result, consequence - 💡 Memory tip: effect (n) ≠ affect (v)! ### 671. cause (n.) - Definition: the reason for something - תרגום: סיבה - Example 1: What's the cause of the problem? - Example 2: Smoking is a cause of cancer. - Synonyms: reason, source - Antonyms: effect, result - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: to cause = לגרום. ### 672. consequence (n.) - Definition: a result of an action - תרגום: השלכה, תוצאה - Example 1: Actions have consequences. - Example 2: The consequences are serious. - Synonyms: result, effect - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי ורשמי. ### 673. reason (n.) - Definition: a cause; the ability to think - תרגום: סיבה; שיקול דעת - Example 1: There's no reason to worry. - Example 2: Use your reason. - Synonyms: cause, logic - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים. ### 674. purpose (n.) - Definition: the reason for doing something - תרגום: מטרה - Example 1: What's the purpose of this meeting? - Example 2: Life needs a purpose. - Synonyms: aim, goal - 💡 Memory tip: on purpose = בכוונה. ### 675. goal (n.) - Definition: something you want to achieve - תרגום: מטרה - Example 1: Set clear goals. - Example 2: My goal is to learn English. - Synonyms: aim, target, objective - 💡 Memory tip: גם: שער (בכדורגל). ### 676. aim (n.) - Definition: a goal - תרגום: מטרה, כוונה - Example 1: Our aim is to help people. - Example 2: She took careful aim. - Synonyms: goal, target - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-goal. ### 677. objective (n.) - Definition: a goal (formal) - תרגום: יעד - Example 1: Our objective is clear. - Example 2: What are your objectives? - Synonyms: aim, goal, target - 💡 Memory tip: אקדמי ועסקי. ### 678. issue (n.) - Definition: an important topic - תרגום: נושא, סוגייה - Example 1: Climate change is a serious issue. - Example 2: We have several issues to discuss. - Synonyms: problem, topic, matter - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: to issue = להנפיק. ### 679. matter (n.) - Definition: a subject; physical substance - תרגום: עניין; חומר - Example 1: It's a serious matter. - Example 2: What's the matter? - Synonyms: issue, topic - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: "it doesn't matter" = זה לא משנה. ### 680. conflict (n.) -
