Definition: a serious disagreement - תרגום: סכסוך, קונפליקט - Example 1: There's conflict between them. - Example 2: The conflict lasted years. - Synonyms: disagreement, dispute - Antonyms: peace, agreement - 💡 Memory tip: הגייה: שם עצם /ˈkɒnflɪkt/. ### 681. agreement (n.) - Definition: a decision made together - תרגום: הסכם, הסכמה - Example 1: They reached an agreement. - Example 2: Sign the agreement here. - Synonyms: deal, contract - Antonyms: disagreement, conflict - 💡 Memory tip: מ-agree. ### 682. disagreement (n.) - Definition: a difference of opinion - תרגום: אי-הסכמה - Example 1: We had a disagreement. - Example 2: Disagreements are normal. - Synonyms: dispute, conflict - Antonyms: agreement - 💡 Memory tip: dis- + agreement. ### 683. culture (n.) - Definition: the customs and beliefs of a group - תרגום: תרבות - Example 1: Every country has its own culture. - Example 2: I love Italian culture. - Synonyms: heritage, civilization - 💡 Memory tip: cultural (adj). ### 684. tradition (n.) - Definition: a custom passed down - תרגום: מסורת - Example 1: It's a family tradition. - Example 2: Traditions change over time. - Synonyms: custom, heritage - 💡 Memory tip: traditional (adj). ### 685. custom (n.) - Definition: a traditional practice - תרגום: מנהג - Example 1: Shaking hands is a custom. - Example 2: Every country has its customs. - Synonyms: tradition, practice - 💡 Memory tip: גם: "customs" = מכס (נמל-תעופה). ### 686. religion (n.) - Definition: belief in God/gods - תרגום: דת - Example 1: He respects all religions. - Example 2: Religion is a personal matter. - Synonyms: faith, belief - 💡 Memory tip: religious (adj). ### 687. belief (n.) - Definition: something you think is true - תרגום: אמונה, דעה - Example 1: Hold on to your beliefs. - Example 2: I have a strong belief in peace. - Synonyms: faith, opinion - 💡 Memory tip: מ-believe (פועל). ### 688. opinion (n.) - Definition: a personal view - תרגום: דעה - Example 1: In my opinion, he's right. - Example 2: Share your opinion. - Synonyms: view, belief, thought - 💡 Memory tip: in my opinion = ביטוי חשוב במבחן. ### 689. attitude (n.) - Definition: a way of thinking or feeling - תרגום: גישה, יחס - Example 1: She has a positive attitude. - Example 2: Change your attitude! - Synonyms: approach, outlook - 💡 Memory tip: positive/negative attitude - Collocations. ### 690. behavior (n.) / behaviour (British) - Definition: the way someone acts - תרגום: התנהגות - Example 1: Her behavior is unusual. - Example 2: Good behavior is expected. - Synonyms: conduct, manner - 💡 Memory tip: American: behavior. British: behaviour. --- # 💼 קטגוריה 2: עולם העבודה והמקצועות (40 מילים) ### 691. career (n.) - Definition: a long-term profession - תרגום: קריירה - Example 1: She has a successful career. - Example 2: Choose your career wisely. - Synonyms: profession, vocation - 💡 Memory tip: קריירה = משרת חיים. ### 692. profession (n.) - Definition: a type of work requiring training - תרגום: מקצוע - Example 1: Teaching is a noble profession. - Example 2: Medicine is his profession. - Synonyms: career, occupation - 💡 Memory tip: professional (adj). ### 693. occupation (n.) - Definition: one's job - תרגום: עיסוק, מקצוע - Example 1: What's your occupation? body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #2 – רמת Intermediate ## חלק ד': 50 תארי פועל ומילות חיבור מבנה: 50 מילים מתקדמות שחיוניות בכתיבה אקדמית ובמבחן --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. תארי פועל של דרך (951-970) - 20 מילים 2. מילות קישור אקדמיות (971-985) - 15 מילים 3. ביטויי דעה והדגשה (986-1000) - 15 מילים --- # 🎯 קטגוריה 1: תארי פועל של דרך (20 מילים) ### 951. clearly (adv.) - Definition: in a clear way; obviously - תרגום: בבירור, באופן ברור - Example 1: Please speak clearly. - Example 2: Clearly, she's upset. - Synonyms: obviously, evidently - 💡 Memory tip: מ-clear + -ly. ### 952. obviously (adv.) - Definition: in an obvious way - תרגום: באופן ברור - Example 1: Obviously, he's angry. - Example 2: She's obviously tired. - Synonyms: clearly, evidently - 💡 Memory tip: משמש בתחילת משפט לחיזוק. ### 953. probably (adv.) - Definition: most likely - תרגום: כנראה - Example 1: It will probably rain. - Example 2: She's probably right. - Synonyms: likely, presumably - 💡 Memory tip: 70-80% סיכוי. ### 954. definitely (adv.) - Definition: without any doubt - תרגום: ללא ספק, בהחלט - Example 1: I'll definitely come. - Example 2: Definitely not. - Synonyms: certainly, surely - Antonyms: maybe - 💡 Memory tip: 100% בטחון. ### 955. certainly (adv.) - Definition: without doubt - תרגום: בוודאי - Example 1: I'll certainly help. - Example 2: She's certainly intelligent. - Synonyms: definitely, surely - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-definitely. ### 956. perhaps (adv.) - Definition: possibly - תרגום: אולי - Example 1: Perhaps we should wait. - Example 2: Perhaps she's right. - Synonyms: maybe, possibly - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-maybe. ### 957. recently (adv.) - Definition: a short time ago - תרגום: לאחרונה - Example 1: I recently moved to Tel Aviv. - Example 2: She recently got married. - Synonyms: lately - 💡 Memory tip: לרוב עם Present Perfect. ### 958. immediately (adv.) - Definition: right now; Nevertheless, we went out. - Example 2: She's difficult; nevertheless, I respect her. - Synonyms: however, nonetheless - 💡 Memory tip: never + the + less - ובכל זאת. ### 976. nonetheless (adv.) - Definition: nevertheless - תרגום: עם זאת - Example 1: The plan failed. Nonetheless, we learned much. - Example 2: Nonetheless, I appreciate the effort. - Synonyms: nevertheless, however - 💡 Memory tip: זהה ל-nevertheless. ### 977. consequently (adv.) - Definition: as a result - תרגום: כתוצאה מכך - Example 1: He didn't study; consequently, he failed. - Example 2: Consequently, we lost money. - Synonyms: therefore, thus - 💡 Memory tip: מ-consequence. ### 978. thus (adv.) - Definition: therefore; in this way - תרגום: וכך, לכן - Example 1: The experiment failed; thus, we started over. - Example 2: Thus, we arrived at our conclusion. - Synonyms: therefore, hence - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד; כתיבה אקדמית. ### 979. hence (adv.) - Definition: for this reason - תרגום: ומכאן, לכן - Example 1: There's no evidence; hence, no conviction. - Example 2: He's young; hence, inexperienced. - Synonyms: therefore, thus - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי וספרותי. ### 980. although (conj.) - already covered. Skipping. ### 980. whereas (conj.) - Definition: while; in contrast - תרגום: בעוד, בניגוד - Example 1: He's rich, whereas she's poor. - Example 2: I like coffee, whereas she prefers tea. - Synonyms: while - 💡 Memory tip: חיבור של ניגוד פורמלי. ### 981. unless (conj.) - Definition: except if - תרגום: אלא אם כן - Example 1: I won't go unless you come. - Example 2: Unless it rains, we'll play. - Synonyms: except if - 💡 Memory tip: if not = unless. ### 982. besides (prep./adv.) - Definition: in addition to - תרגום: בנוסף ל- - Example 1: Besides English, she speaks French. - Example 2: I don't want to go; besides, it's late. - Synonyms: apart from, additionally - 💡 Memory tip: להבדיל מ-beside (ליד) - besides = בנוסף. ### 983. instead (adv.) - Definition: as an alternative - תרגום: במקום זאת - Example 1: Let's stay home instead. - Example 2: Instead of coffee, I'll have tea. - Synonyms: alternatively, rather - 💡 Memory tip: instead of X = במקום X. ### 984. according to (prep.) - Definition: as stated by - תרגום: לפי, על פי - Example 1: According to the report, sales are up. - Example 2: According to her, it's easy. - Synonyms: based on - 💡 Memory tip: תמיד according to X, לא "according X". ### 985. whereas - already covered. Skipping. ### 985. despite (prep.) - Definition: in spite of - תרגום: למרות - Example 1: Despite the rain, we went out. - Example 2: Despite her age, she runs marathons. - Synonyms: in spite of - 💡 Memory tip: despite = in spite of. בלי of אחרי despite! --- # 💬 קטגוריה 3: ביטויי דעה והדגשה (15 מילים) ### 986. indeed (adv.) - Definition: really; truly - תרגום: אכן - Example 1: She is indeed talented. - Example 2: "Are you happy?" "Indeed, I am." - Synonyms: certainly, truly - 💡 Memory tip: להדגיש אמת. ### 987. truly (adv.) - Definition: in a real and sincere way - תרגום: באמת, באמת ובתמים - Example 1: I truly believe it. - Example 2: She was truly sorry. - Synonyms: genuinely, really - 💡 Memory tip: מ-true. ### 988. honestly (adv.) - Definition: in a truthful way - תרגום: בכנות - Example 1: Honestly, I don't know. - Example 2: She answered honestly. - Synonyms: truthfully, sincerely - 💡 Memory tip: מ-honest. ### 989. frankly (adv.) - Definition: openly and directly - תרגום: בגילוי לב - Example 1: Frankly, I'm disappointed. - Example 2: To speak frankly, it's terrible. - Synonyms: honestly, openly - 💡 Memory tip: פותח משפט לדעה ישירה. ### 990. personally (adv.) - Definition: in one's personal opinion - תרגום: אישית - Example 1: Personally, I disagree. - Example 2: She took the comment personally. - Synonyms: individually - 💡 Memory tip: להציג דעה אישית. ### 991. absolutely (adv.) - Definition: completely - תרגום: לחלוטין - Example 1: I absolutely agree. - Example 2: That's absolutely correct. - Synonyms: completely, totally - 💡 Memory tip: חזק מאוד - 100%. ### 992. entirely (adv.) - Definition: completely - תרגום: לגמרי - Example 1: I'm entirely satisfied. - Example 2: The problem is entirely solved. - Synonyms: completely, totally - 💡 Memory tip: מ-entire (שלם). ### 993. barely (adv.) - Definition: almost not - תרגום: בקושי - Example 1: I can barely hear you. - Example 2: She barely ate anything. - Synonyms: hardly, scarcely - 💡 Memory tip: דומה ל-hardly. ### 994. scarcely (adv.) - Definition: almost not - תרגום: בקושי, כמעט ולא - Example 1: I scarcely know him. - Example 2: Scarcely had I arrived when... - Synonyms: hardly, barely - 💡 Memory tip: מ-scarce (נדיר). ### 995. extremely (adv.) - Definition: very much - תרגום: מאוד מאוד - Example 1: It's extremely cold. - Example 2: She's extremely talented. - Synonyms: very, highly - 💡 Memory tip: מ-extreme. ### 996. highly (adv.) - Definition: to a great degree - תרגום: מאוד (באיכות) - Example 1: I highly recommend this book. - Example 2: She's highly skilled. - Synonyms: extremely, very - 💡 Memory tip: יוקרתי - highly educated. ### 997. rather (adv.) - Definition: quite; preferably - תרגום: די; במקום - Example 1: It's rather cold today. - Example 2: I'd rather stay home. - Synonyms: quite, somewhat - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: די / מעדיף. ### 998. fairly (adv.) - Definition: quite; reasonably - תרגום: די, למדי - Example 1: It's fairly easy. - Example 2: She did fairly well. - Synonyms: quite, rather - 💡 Memory tip: מ-fair (הוגן). פחות חזק מ-very. ### 999. quite (adv.) - Definition: fairly; completely - תרגום: די, לגמרי - Example 1: It's quite nice. - Example 2: I'm quite sure. - Synonyms: rather, fairly - 💡 Memory tip: זהירות: quite ≠ quiet! שני מובנים: די / לגמרי. ### 1000. indeed - already covered. ### 1000. regardless (adv.) - Definition: in spite of everything - תרגום: ללא תלות, למרות הכל - Example 1: Regardless of the weather, we'll go. - Example 2: I love her regardless. - Synonyms: nonetheless, anyway - 💡 Memory tip: regardless of X = בלי קשר ל-X. --- # 🎉 סיום חבילה 2 - Intermediate! ## 🏆 כל הכבוד! השלמת את 500 המילים הבינוניות של הקורס! ### סיכום חבילה 2: - title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #3 – רמת Advanced ## חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) - רמה מתקדמת מבנה: 150 פעלים ברמה אקדמית-מתקדמת - משמש
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #3 – רמת Advanced ## חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) - רמה מתקדמת מבנה: 150 פעלים ברמה אקדמית-מתקדמת - משמשים בטקסטים מדעיים, ספרותיים ומשפטיים --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. פעלי מחקר וטיעון אקדמי (1001-1030) - 30 מילים 2. פעלי ביקורת ודיון (1031-1060) - 30 מילים 3. פעלי שינוי ועיצוב (1061-1090) - 30 מילים 4. פעלי יחסים והשפעה (1091-1120) - 30 מילים 5. פעלים פורמליים מתקדמים (1121-1150) - 30 מילים --- # 🔬 קטגוריה 1: פעלי מחקר וטיעון אקדמי (30 מילים) ### 1001. assert (v.) - Definition: to state firmly - תרגום: לטעון בתוקף - Example 1: She asserted her rights. - Example 2: The author asserts that climate change is man-made. - Synonyms: claim, declare, maintain - Antonyms: deny - 💡 Memory tip: חזק יותר מ-state - טיעון בתוקף. ### 1002. claim (v.) - Definition: to state without proof - תרגום: לטעון - Example 1: He claims to be innocent. - Example 2: The company claims to be eco-friendly. - Synonyms: assert, maintain - 💡 Memory tip: טיעון שעשוי להיות נכון או לא. ### 1003. contend (v.) - Definition: to argue strongly - תרגום: לטעון, להתמודד - Example 1: Scientists contend that the theory is flawed. - Example 2: She had to contend with many problems. - Synonyms: argue, maintain - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: לטעון / להתמודד. ### 1004. maintain (v.) - Definition: to keep asserting - תרגום: להחזיק בדעה, לטעון - Example 1: He maintains his innocence. - Example 2: She maintains that exercise is key. - Synonyms: assert, claim - 💡 Memory tip: התמדה בטענה לאורך זמן. ### 1005. postulate (v.) - Definition: to suggest a theory as true - תרגום: להציע כאקסיומה - Example 1: Einstein postulated the theory of relativity. - Example 2: We postulate that gravity is universal. - Synonyms: propose, theorize - 💡 Memory tip: מדעי - הצעה לצורך בדיקה. ### 1006. hypothesize (v.) - Definition: to make a hypothesis - תרגום: לשער, להציע היפותזה - Example 1: Scientists hypothesize that water existed on Mars. - Example 2: We can hypothesize the outcome. - Synonyms: theorize, speculate - 💡 Memory tip: מ-hypothesis (השערה). ### 1007. speculate (v.) - Definition: to think or guess without sure knowledge - תרגום: לשער, לנחש - Example 1: Don't speculate without evidence. - Example 2: The media speculated about the result. - Synonyms: guess, theorize - 💡 Memory tip: השערה ללא יסוד מוצק. ### 1008. deduce (v.) - Definition: to conclude through logic - תרגום: להסיק - Example 1: From the clues, she deduced the answer. - Example 2: We can deduce the cause. - Synonyms: conclude, infer - 💡 Memory tip: מסקנה הגיונית. ### 1009. infer (v.) - Definition: to conclude from evidence - תרגום: להסיק - Example 1: What can we infer from the data? - Example 2: Readers must infer the meaning. - Synonyms: deduce, conclude - 💡 Memory tip: infer (הקורא מסיק) ≠ imply (הכותב רומז). ### 1010. conclude (v.) - Definition: to reach a decision by reasoning - תרגום: להסיק - Example 1: We conclude that the hypothesis is correct. - Example 2: The article concludes with a warning. - Synonyms: deduce, determine - 💡 Memory tip: גם: לסיים (conclude a meeting). ### 1011. substantiate (v.) - Definition: to support with evidence - תרגום: לבסס - Example 1: Can you substantiate your claim? - Example 2: Documents substantiate the story. - Synonyms: prove, support, verify - 💡 Memory tip: מ-substance (מהות). ### 1012. corroborate (v.) - Definition: to confirm or give support to - תרגום: לאמת, לאשש - Example 1: The witness corroborated his story. - Example 2: The evidence corroborates our theory. - Synonyms: confirm, verify, support - 💡 Memory tip: אישור חיצוני לטיעון. ### 1013. validate (v.) - Definition: to prove valid - תרגום: לאמת, לאשש - Example 1: The study validates our approach. - Example 2: Please validate your ticket. - Synonyms: confirm, verify - 💡 Memory tip: מ-valid (תקף). ### 1014. refute (v.) - Definition: to prove wrong - תרגום: להפריך - Example 1: Scientists refuted the old theory. - Example 2: She refuted his argument. - Synonyms: disprove, rebut - Antonyms: confirm, support - 💡 Memory tip: הפרכה פורמלית. ### 1015. dispute (v.) - Definition: to argue against - תרגום: לחלוק, לערער - Example 1: I don't dispute the facts. - Example 2: The companies disputed the contract. - Synonyms: contest, challenge - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: מחלוקת. ### 1016. challenge (v.) - Definition: to question; to invite to compete - תרגום: לערער, לאתגר - Example 1: She challenged his authority. - Example 2: I challenge you to a game. - Synonyms: question, contest, dispute - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם. ### 1017. acknowledge (v.) - Definition: to accept or admit - תרגום: להכיר, להודות - Example 1: He acknowledged his mistake. - Example 2: The government acknowledged the problem. - Synonyms: admit, recognize - Antonyms: deny - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-admit. ### 1018. recognize (v.) - Definition: to accept as valid - תרגום: להכיר, לזהות - Example 1: We recognize her contribution. - Example 2: The court recognized the agreement. - Synonyms: acknowledge, accept - 💡 Memory tip: גם: לזהות ויזואלית. ### 1019. attribute (v.) - Definition: to assign as belonging to - תרגום: לייחס - Example 1: They attribute the success to hard work. - Example 2: The painting is attributed to Picasso. - Synonyms: credit, ascribe - 💡 Memory tip: attribute X to Y = לייחס X ל-Y. ### 1020. ascribe (v.) - Definition: to attribute to - תרגום: לייחס - Example 1: He ascribed his success to luck. - Example 2: The poem is ascribed to an unknown author. - Synonyms: attribute, credit - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי יותר מ-attribute. ### 1021. comprise (v.) - Definition: to consist of - תרגום: מורכב מ- - Example 1: The team comprises ten members. - Example 2: The book comprises three parts. - Synonyms: consist of, include - 💡 Memory tip: comprise X (ללא "of"!). consist of X (עם "of"). ### 1022. encompass (v.) - Definition: to include; to surround - תרגום: לכלול, להקיף - Example 1: The study encompasses many fields. - Example 2: His knowledge encompasses history and science. - Synonyms: include, cover - 💡 Memory tip: תופס באופן רחב. ### 1023. incorporate (v.) - Definition: to include as part of - תרגום: לשלב, לכלול - Example 1: The design incorporates new features. - Example 2: We should incorporate her ideas. - Synonyms: include, integrate - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי להוספה. ### 1024. integrate (v.) - Definition: to combine into a whole - תרגום: לשלב - Example 1: We need to integrate these systems. - Example 2: Immigrants integrate into society. - Synonyms: combine, merge - Antonyms: separate - 💡 Memory tip: שילוב לכדי שלם אחד. ### 1025. synthesize (v.) - Definition: to combine elements - תרגום: לסנתז, לצרף - Example 1: The chemist synthesized a new compound. - Example 2: She synthesized information from many sources. - Synonyms: combine, integrate - 💡 Memory tip: במדע: ליצור חומר. באקדמיה: לצרף מידע. ### 1026. construct (v.) - Definition: to build - תרגום: לבנות - Example 1: They're constructing a new bridge. - Example 2: She constructed a strong argument. - Synonyms: build, create - Antonyms: destroy, demolish - 💡 Memory tip: פיזי ומטפורי. ### 1027. derive (v.) - Definition: to obtain from a source - תרגום: לגזור, להפיק - Example 1: Sugar is derived from sugarcane. - Example 2: He derives satisfaction from his work. - Synonyms: obtain, gain - 💡 Memory tip: derive X from Y = להפיק X מ-Y. ### 1028. originate (v.) - Definition: to come from - תרגום: להיווצר, להתחיל - Example 1: The tradition originated in China. - Example 2: Where did this idea originate? - Synonyms: begin, emerge - 💡 Memory tip: מ-origin (מקור). ### 1029. emerge (v.) - Definition: to appear; to become known - תרגום: להתגלות, לצוץ - Example 1: New evidence has emerged. - Example 2: She emerged as a leader. - Synonyms: appear, arise - Antonyms: disappear, vanish - 💡 Memory tip: יציאה מתוך חשכה/אלמוניות. ### 1030. arise (v.) - Definition: to emerge; to result - תרגום: לקום, להתעורר - Example 1: Problems may arise. - Example 2: A new opportunity has arisen. - Synonyms: emerge, appear - 💡 Memory tip: Forms: arise/arises/arose/arisen. --- # 💬 קטגוריה 2: פעלי ביקורת ודיון (30 מילים) ### 1031. criticize (v.) - Definition: to express disapproval - תרגום: לבקר - Example 1: The report was heavily criticized. - Example 2: Don't criticize without understanding. - Synonyms: disparage, condemn - Antonyms: praise, commend - 💡 Memory tip: Also spelled criticise (British). ### 1032. condemn (v.) - Definition: to strongly disapprove - תרגום: לגנות - Example 1: Leaders condemned the violence. - Example 2: The action was widely condemned. - Synonyms: denounce, criticize - Antonyms: praise, approve - 💡 Memory tip: חזק מאוד - גינוי רשמי. ### 1033. denounce (v.) - Definition: to publicly condemn - תרגום: לגנות בפומבי - Example 1: The senator denounced the policy. - Example 2: He denounced the corruption. - Synonyms: condemn, criticize - 💡 Memory tip: גינוי פומבי/רשמי. ### 1034. critique (v.) - Definition: to review critically - תרגום: לבקר (באופן מנומק) - Example 1: Students will critique each other's papers. - Example 2: She critiqued the film's direction. - Synonyms: review, analyze - 💡 Memory tip: ביקורת מנומקת ומקצועית - לא בהכרח שלילית. ### 1035. dismiss (v.) - Definition: to reject; to send away - תרגום: לדחות, לפטר - Example 1: Don't dismiss my idea. - Example 2: She was dismissed from her job. - Synonyms: reject, fire - Antonyms: accept, hire - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: לדחות רעיון / לפטר מעבודה. ### 1036. reject - already covered at #523. Skipping. ### 1036. decline (v.) - Definition: to politely refuse; to decrease - תרגום: לסרב (בנימוס); לרדת - Example 1: She declined the invitation. - Example 2: Sales have declined recently. - Synonyms: refuse, decrease - Antonyms: accept; increase - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים לגמרי שונים. ### 1037. object (v.) - Definition: to oppose - תרגום: להתנגד - Example 1: I object to this proposal. - Example 2: Do you object? - Synonyms: oppose, protest - Antonyms: agree, approve - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: חפץ. הגייה שונה! ### 1038. oppose (v.) - Definition: to be against - תרגום: להתנגד - Example 1: Many oppose the new law. - Example 2: She opposes his ideas. - Synonyms: object, contest - Antonyms: support - 💡 Memory tip: מ-opposite (הפוך). ### 1039. contradict (v.) - Definition: to say the opposite - תרגום: לסתור - Example 1: His words contradict his actions. - Example 2: Don't contradict me! - Synonyms: dispute, oppose - Antonyms: confirm, agree - 💡 Memory tip: contra- = נגד + -dict = לומר. ### 1040. protest (v.) - Definition: to express strong disapproval - תרגום: למחות - Example 1: They protested against the war. - Example 2: I protest this decision. - Synonyms: object, complain - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: הפגנה. ### 1041. advocate (v.) - Definition: to publicly support - תרגום: לתמוך, להטיף בעד - Example 1: She advocates for women's rights. - Example 2: He advocates a healthy lifestyle. - Synonyms: support, champion - Antonyms: oppose - 💡 Memory tip: גם שם עצם: תומך מוצהר. ### 1042. endorse (v.) - Definition: to publicly support - תרגום: לתמוך בפומבי, להמליץ - Example 1: The senator endorsed the candidate. - Example 2: The doctor endorses this product. - Synonyms: support, approve - 💡 Memory tip: פומבי, רשמי. ### 1043. sanction (v.) - Definition: to officially approve; to impose penalties - תרגום: לאשר; להטיל סנקציות - Example 1: The law sanctions the use of force. - Example 2: Countries sanctioned the regime. - Synonyms: approve, permit; penalize - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים הפוכים! ### 1044. approve - already covered at #524. Skipping. ### 1044. commend (v.) - Definition: to praise formally - תרגום: לשבח - Example 1: The teacher commended her work. - Example 2: He was commended for bravery. - Synonyms: praise, applaud - Antonyms: criticize - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מ-praise. ### 1045. applaud (v.) - Definition: to clap; to express approval - תרגום: למחוא כפיים, לשבח - Example 1: The audience applauded. - Example 2: I applaud your decision. - Synonyms: praise, commend - 💡 Memory tip: גם ממש (מחיאת

title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #3 – רמת Advanced ## חלק ב': 200 שמות עצם (Nouns) - רמה מתקדמת מבנה: 200 שמות עצם ברמה אקדמית-מתקדמת
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #3 – רמת Advanced ## חלק ב': 200 שמות עצם (Nouns) - רמה מתקדמת מבנה: 200 שמות עצם ברמה אקדמית-מתקדמת - מונחים מדעיים, פילוסופיים וחברתיים --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. מושגים פילוסופיים ומוסריים (1151-1190) - 40 מילים 2. מושגים מדעיים ומחקריים (1191-1230) - 40 מילים 3. מושגים כלכליים ועסקיים (1231-1270) - 40 מילים 4. מושגים פסיכולוגיים וחברתיים (1271-1310) - 40 מילים 5. מונחים משפטיים ופוליטיים (1311-1350) - 40 מילים --- # 🤔 קטגוריה 1: מושגים פילוסופיים ומוסריים (40 מילים) ### 1151. philosophy (n.) - Definition: the study of fundamental questions - תרגום: פילוסופיה - Example 1: She studies ancient philosophy. - Example 2: His philosophy of life is simple. - Synonyms: thinking, ideology - 💡 Memory tip: philo (אהבה) + sophy (חוכמה). ### 1152. ideology (n.) - Definition: a system of ideas - תרגום: אידיאולוגיה - Example 1: Political ideologies differ. - Example 2: His ideology influenced millions. - Synonyms: philosophy, beliefs - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: ideologies. ### 1153. principle (n.) - Definition: a fundamental truth or rule - תרגום: עיקרון - Example 1: It's a matter of principle. - Example 2: The principles of democracy. - Synonyms: rule, belief - 💡 Memory tip: זהירות: principle (עיקרון) ≠ principal (מנהל). ### 1154. ethics (n.) - Definition: moral principles - תרגום: אתיקה, מוסר - Example 1: Medical ethics are important. - Example 2: Ethics guide our decisions. - Synonyms: morals, morality - 💡 Memory tip: תמיד ברבים אבל יחיד בגרמטיקה. ### 1155. morality (n.) - Definition: principles of right and wrong - תרגום: מוסר - Example 1: Morality varies across cultures. - Example 2: He questioned the morality of the act. - Synonyms: ethics, virtue - 💡 Memory tip: מ-moral. ### 1156. virtue (n.) - Definition: moral excellence - תרגום: מעלה, סגולה - Example 1: Patience is a virtue. - Example 2: Honesty is his greatest virtue. - Synonyms: goodness, merit - Antonyms: vice - 💡 Memory tip: virtuous (adj) = צדיק. ### 1157. vice (n.) - already covered at #795. Synonyms: facet, side - 💡 Memory tip: פן מסוים של דבר. ### 1178. dimension (n.) - Definition: a measurable aspect - תרגום: ממד - Example 1: It has multiple dimensions. - Example 2: The dimension of the room is small. - Synonyms: aspect, measurement - 💡 Memory tip: גם פיזי וגם מטפורי. ### 1179. scope (n.) - Definition: the range covered - תרגום: היקף - Example 1: The scope of the project is huge. - Example 2: That's beyond my scope. - Synonyms: range, extent - 💡 Memory tip: היקף, טווח. ### 1180. extent (n.) - Definition: the degree to which - תרגום: מידה, היקף - Example 1: To some extent, I agree. - Example 2: The extent of damage was great. - Synonyms: degree, scope - 💡 Memory tip: to some/a great extent - Collocations. ### 1181. context (n.) - Definition: the surrounding circumstances - תרגום: הקשר - Example 1: Understand the context first. - Example 2: Words have different meanings in context. - Synonyms: setting, circumstances - 💡 Memory tip: contextual (adj). ### 1182. framework (n.) - Definition: a basic structure - תרגום: מסגרת - Example 1: The legal framework is complex. - Example 2: Build a strong framework. - Synonyms: structure, system - 💡 Memory tip: frame + work - מסגרת. ### 1183. paradigm (n.) - Definition: a model or example - תרגום: פרדיגמה, מודל - Example 1: A new paradigm emerged. - Example 2: The paradigm shift changed science. - Synonyms: model, pattern - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד - משמש בשפה אקדמית. ### 1184. phenomenon (n.) - Definition: an observable fact - תרגום: תופעה - Example 1: Climate change is a global phenomenon. - Example 2: Strange phenomena were reported. - Synonyms: occurrence, event - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: phenomena. ### 1185. anomaly (n.) - Definition: something unusual - תרגום: חריגה, חריג - Example 1: An anomaly was detected. - Example 2: His behavior is an anomaly. - Synonyms: exception, irregularity - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: anomalies. ### 1186. exception (n.) - Definition: something different from the rule - תרגום: חריג - Example 1: There's no exception to this rule. - Example 2: She's an exception. - Synonyms: anomaly, exclusion - 💡 Memory tip: מ-except. ### 1187. pattern (n.) - Definition: a regular arrangement - תרגום: דפוס, תבנית - Example 1: I see a pattern in the data. - Example 2: She follows a pattern of success. - Synonyms: design, model - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: patterns. ### 1188. trend (n.) - Definition: a general direction - תרגום: מגמה - Example 1: The latest trend in fashion. - Example 2: A disturbing trend was noted. - Synonyms: tendency, movement - 💡 Memory tip: trendy (adj) = עדכני. ### 1189. tendency (n.) - Definition: an inclination - תרגום: נטייה - Example 1: There's a tendency to forget. - Example 2: Her tendency is to overthink. - Synonyms: trend, inclination - 💡 Memory tip: מ-tend. ### 1190. inclination (n.) - Definition: a natural tendency - תרגום: נטייה - Example 1: I have an inclination to agree. - Example 2: Follow your inclinations. - Synonyms: tendency, preference - 💡 Memory tip: גם פיזי: הטייה. --- # 🔬 קטגוריה 2: מושגים מדעיים ומחקריים (40 מילים) ### 1191. hypothesis (n.) - Definition: a proposed explanation - תרגום: השערה - Example 1: Test the hypothesis. - Example 2: The hypothesis was rejected. - Synonyms: theory, assumption - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: hypotheses. ### 1192. theory - already covered at #744. Skipping. ### 1192. methodology (n.) - Definition: a system of methods - תרגום: מתודולוגיה - Example 1: The methodology is sound. - Example 2: Research methodology matters. - Synonyms: method, approach - 💡 Memory tip: method + -ology. ### 1193. variable (n.) - Definition: a changing element - תרגום: משתנה - Example 1: Control the variables. - Example 2: Weather is a variable. - Synonyms: factor, element - 💡 Memory tip: גם תואר: משתנה. ### 1194. constant (n.) - Definition: something unchanging - תרגום: קבוע - Example 1: Change is the only constant. - Example 2: Gravity is a constant. - Synonyms: invariable - Antonyms: variable - 💡 Memory tip: גם תואר. ### 1195. factor (n.) - Definition: a contributing element - תרגום: גורם - Example 1: Many factors affect success. - Example 2: Cost is a key factor. - Synonyms: element, component - 💡 Memory tip: גם במתמטיקה (factor). ### 1196. element (n.) - Definition: a part of something - תרגום: מרכיב, יסוד - Example 1: Trust is a key element. - Example 2: The periodic table of elements. - Synonyms: component, factor - 💡 Memory tip: בכימיה וגם בחיים. ### 1197. component (n.) - Definition: a part - תרגום: רכיב - Example 1: Every component is important. - Example 2: Computer components are expensive. - Synonyms: part, element - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: components. ### 1198. aspect - already covered at #1177. Skipping. ### 1198. criteria (n.) / criterion (singular) - Definition: standards for judging - תרגום: קריטריונים - Example 1: The criteria are strict. - Example 2: What are the selection criteria? - Synonyms: standards, requirements - 💡 Memory tip: Singular: criterion. title: # חבילת אוצר מילים #3 – רמת Advanced ## חלק ג': 100 תארים (Adjectives) - רמה מתקדמת מבנה: 100 תארים ברמה אקדמית-ספרותית
body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #3 – רמת Advanced ## חלק ג': 100 תארים (Adjectives) - רמה מתקדמת מבנה: 100 תארים ברמה אקדמית-ספרותית - לתיאורים מדויקים ומעמיקים --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. תיאורים אנליטיים (1351-1375) - 25 מילים 2. תארי אופי מתקדמים (1376-1400) - 25 מילים 3. תארי רמה ואיכות (1401-1425) - 25 מילים 4. תארים אקדמיים ספרותיים (1426-1450) - 25 מילים --- # 🔍 קטגוריה 1: תיאורים אנליטיים (25 מילים) ### 1351. analytical (adj.) - Definition: using logical analysis - תרגום: אנליטי - Example 1: She has an analytical mind. - Example 2: An analytical approach is needed. - Synonyms: logical, systematic - 💡 Memory tip: מ-analysis. ### 1352. systematic (adj.) - Definition: methodical - תרגום: שיטתי - Example 1: A systematic approach works best. - Example 2: Systematic errors must be fixed. - Synonyms: organized, methodical - Antonyms: random, chaotic - 💡 Memory tip: מ-system. ### 1353. rigorous (adj.) - Definition: thorough and careful - תרגום: קפדני - Example 1: Rigorous research is needed. - Example 2: The training was rigorous. - Synonyms: strict, thorough - Antonyms: lax - 💡 Memory tip: דרישה גבוהה ומדויקת. ### 1354. thorough (adj.) - Definition: complete and careful - תרגום: יסודי - Example 1: A thorough investigation. - Example 2: She's thorough in her work. - Synonyms: comprehensive, detailed - Antonyms: superficial - 💡 Memory tip: ביצוע עמוק ומקיף. ### 1355. comprehensive (adj.) - Definition: complete; including everything - תרגום: מקיף - Example 1: A comprehensive study. - Example 2: Comprehensive health insurance. - Synonyms: thorough, complete - Antonyms: partial, limited - 💡 Memory tip: מכסה את הכל. ### 1356. superficial (adj.) - Definition: shallow; not deep - תרגום: שטחי - Example 1: A superficial analysis. - Example 2: His knowledge is superficial. - Synonyms: shallow, surface - Antonyms: deep, thorough - 💡 Memory tip: super- = על פני השטח. ### 1357. profound (adj.) - Definition: very deep or intense - תרגום: עמוק - Example 1: A profound thought. - Example 2: She had a profound impact. - Synonyms: deep, significant - Antonyms: superficial, shallow - 💡 Memory tip: עומק רעיוני או רגשי. ### 1358. fundamental (adj.) - Definition: basic and essential - תרגום: יסודי, בסיסי - Example 1: Fundamental principles. - Example 2: A fundamental change is needed. - Synonyms: basic, essential - 💡 Memory tip: השורש של משהו. ### 1359. underlying (adj.) - Definition: beneath the surface - תרגום: בסיסי, שביסוד - Example 1: The underlying cause is stress. - Example 2: Underlying assumptions are important. - Synonyms: basic, fundamental - 💡 Memory tip: under-lying = שוכן תחת. ### 1360. explicit (adj.) - Definition: clearly stated - תרגום: מפורש - Example 1: Explicit instructions help. - Example 2: Be explicit about your needs. - Synonyms: clear, direct - Antonyms: implicit, vague - 💡 Memory tip: מפורש וישיר. ### 1361. implicit (adj.) - Definition: implied, not stated - תרגום: משתמע - Example 1: There's an implicit message. - Example 2: Implicit bias affects us all. - Synonyms: unspoken, suggested - Antonyms: explicit - 💡 Memory tip: מ-imply. ### 1362. inherent (adj.) - Definition: existing naturally - תרגום: טבוע, מולד - Example 1: Risk is inherent in business. - Example 2: Inherent qualities can't be changed. - Synonyms: natural, intrinsic - 💡 Memory tip: חלק אינהרנטי מהעצם. ### 1363. intrinsic (adj.) - Definition: essential; naturally part of - תרגום: פנימי, מהותי - Example 1: Intrinsic motivation is strong. - Example 2: The intrinsic value of art. - Synonyms: inherent, essential - Antonyms: extrinsic - 💡 Memory tip: חלק פנימי של משהו. ### 1364. extrinsic (adj.) - Definition: not part of the essential nature - תרגום: חיצוני - Example 1: Extrinsic rewards can demotivate. - Example 2: Extrinsic factors matter too. - Synonyms: external - Antonyms: intrinsic - 💡 Memory tip: ex- = חוץ. ### 1365. objective (adj.) - Definition: not influenced by feelings - תרגום: אובייקטיבי - Example 1: Try to be objective. - Example 2: An objective analysis is best. - Synonyms: unbiased, impartial - Antonyms: subjective - 💡 Memory tip: ללא רגש אישי. ### 1366. subjective (adj.) - Definition: based on personal feelings - תרגום: סובייקטיבי - Example 1: Art is subjective. - Example 2: That's a subjective view. - Synonyms: personal, biased - Antonyms: objective - 💡 Memory tip: תלוי בנקודת מבט אישית. ### 1367. empirical (adj.) - Definition: based on observation or experience - תרגום: אמפירי, מבוסס תצפית - Example 1: Empirical evidence is strong. - Example 2: We need empirical data. - Synonyms: observational, experimental - Antonyms: theoretical - 💡 Memory tip: ממה שרואים, לא ממה שחושבים. ### 1368. theoretical - already covered at #948. Skipping. ### 1368. quantitative (adj.) - Definition: relating to quantity/numbers - תרגום: כמותי - Example 1: Quantitative research uses numbers. - Example 2: Quantitative data is measurable. - Synonyms: numerical - Antonyms: qualitative - 💡 Memory tip: כמות = quantity. ### 1369. qualitative (adj.) - Definition: relating to quality - תרגום: איכותני - Example 1: Qualitative research uses interviews. - Example 2: A qualitative difference. - Synonyms: descriptive - Antonyms: quantitative - 💡 Memory tip: איכות = quality. ### 1370. subjective - covered. ### 1370. reliable - already covered at #878. Skipping. ### 1370. valid (adj.) - Definition: based on truth or logic - תרגום: תקף - Example 1: That's a valid point. - Example 2: The passport is still valid. - Synonyms: sound, legitimate - Antonyms: invalid - 💡 Memory tip: validity (n). ### 1371. invalid (adj.) - Definition: not valid - תרגום: לא תקף - Example 1: The argument is invalid. - Example 2: The check is invalid. - Synonyms: illogical, void - Antonyms: valid - 💡 Memory tip: in- + valid. ### 1372. credible (adj.) - Definition: believable - תרגום: אמין - Example 1: A credible source. - Example 2: Her story is credible. - Synonyms: believable, trustworthy - Antonyms: incredible - 💡 Memory tip: מ-credibility. ### 1373. plausible (adj.) - Definition: seeming reasonable or probable - תרגום: סביר, מתקבל על הדעת - Example 1: A plausible explanation. - Example 2: That's a plausible theory. - Synonyms: believable, reasonable - Antonyms: implausible - 💡 Memory tip: יכול להיות נכון, אבל לא בטוח. ### 1374. coherent (adj.) - Definition: logical and consistent - תרגום: עקבי, הגיוני - Example 1: A coherent argument. - Example 2: Her speech was coherent. - Synonyms: logical, clear - Antonyms: incoherent - 💡 Memory tip: מ-cohere = להיצמד יחד. ### 1375. ambiguous (adj.) - Definition: having more than one meaning - תרגום: דו-משמעי - Example 1: The answer was ambiguous. - Example 2: Avoid ambiguous wording. - Synonyms: vague, unclear - Antonyms: clear, specific - 💡 Memory tip: ambi- = שני. --- # 👤 קטגוריה 2: תארי אופי מתקדמים (25 מילים) ### 1376. articulate (adj.) - Definition: able to express ideas clearly - תרגום: מתבטא היטב - Example 1: She's very articulate. - Example 2: An articulate speaker. - Synonyms: eloquent, well-spoken - Antonyms: inarticulate - 💡 Memory tip: גם פועל: לבטא. ### 1377. eloquent (adj.) - Definition: fluent and persuasive - תרגום: רהוט - Example 1: An eloquent speech. - Example 2: She spoke eloquently. - Synonyms: articulate, expressive - 💡 Memory tip: eloquence (n). ### 1378. diligent (adj.) - Definition: showing care and effort - תרגום: חרוץ - Example 1: A diligent student. - Example 2: Diligent work pays off. - Synonyms: hardworking, industrious - Antonyms: lazy - 💡 Memory tip: עבודה יסודית ומתמשכת. ### 1379. persistent (adj.) - Definition: continuing despite obstacles - תרגום: עקבי, מתמיד - Example 1: She's persistent in her efforts. - Example 2: A persistent problem. - Synonyms: determined, tenacious - 💡 Memory tip: מ-persist. ### 1380. tenacious (adj.) - Definition: holding firmly - תרגום: עיקש - Example 1: A tenacious fighter. - Example 2: She's tenacious about her goals. - Synonyms: persistent, stubborn - 💡 Memory tip: לא מוותר לעולם. ### 1381. resilient (adj.) - Definition: able to recover quickly - תרגום: חסון - Example 1: Children are resilient. - Example 2: A resilient economy. - Synonyms: tough, hardy - Antonyms: fragile - 💡 Memory tip: מתאושש ממכות. ### 1382. fragile (adj.) - Definition: easily broken - תרגום: שביר - Example 1: Handle with care - fragile! - Example 2: A fragile peace. - Synonyms: delicate, breakable - Antonyms: strong, resilient - 💡 Memory tip: פיזי או מטפורי. ### 1383. pragmatic (adj.) - Definition: practical and realistic - תרגום: פרגמטי - Example 1: Take a pragmatic approach. - Example 2: She's pragmatic about it. - Synonyms: practical, realistic - Antonyms: idealistic - 💡 Memory tip: מעשי וריאלי. ### 1384. idealistic (adj.) - Definition: having high ideals - תרגום: אידאליסטי - Example 1: Young people are often idealistic. - Example 2: An idealistic view of the world. - Synonyms: optimistic, utopian - Antonyms: pragmatic, realistic - 💡 Memory tip: מ-ideal. ### 1385. cynical (adj.) - Definition: believing people are selfish - תרגום: ציני - Example 1: Don't be so cynical. - Example 2: A cynical view of politics. - Synonyms: skeptical, distrustful - Antonyms: idealistic - 💡 Memory tip: מפקפק בטוב שבאנשים. ### 1386. skeptical (adj.) - Definition: doubting, questioning - תרגום: ספקני - Example 1: I'm skeptical about his claims. - Example 2: A skeptical scientist. - Synonyms: doubtful, suspicious - Antonyms: trusting, convinced - 💡 Memory tip: skepticism (n). ### 1387. compassionate (adj.) - Definition: showing sympathy - תרגום: חומל - Example 1: A compassionate nurse. - Example 2: Be compassionate with others. - Synonyms: kind, caring - Antonyms: cruel - 💡 Memory tip: מ-compassion. ### 1388. arrogant (adj.) - Definition: overly proud - תרגום: שחצן - Example 1: His arrogant attitude is annoying. - Example 2: Don't be arrogant. - Synonyms: conceited, proud - Antonyms: humble - 💡 Memory tip: מידת גאווה יתר. ### 1389. humble (adj.) - Definition: not proud - תרגום: צנוע - Example 1: A humble person despite success. - Example 2: Humble beginnings. - Synonyms: modest, unassuming - Antonyms: arrogant, proud - 💡 Memory tip: humility (n). ### 1390. modest (adj.) - Definition: not showing off; small - תרגום: צנוע - Example 1: She's modest about her skills. - Example 2: A modest sum of money. - Synonyms: humble, moderate - Antonyms: boastful, excessive - 💡 Memory tip: שני מובנים: צנוע או קטן. ### 1391. assertive (adj.) - Definition: confident and direct - תרגום: אסרטיבי - Example 1: Be assertive, not aggressive. - Example 2: An assertive leader. - Synonyms: confident, firm - Antonyms: passive, timid - 💡 Memory tip: מ-assert. ### 1392. passive (adj.) - Definition: accepting without resistance - תרגום: פסיבי - Example 1: Don't be passive - act! - Example 2: A passive role. - Synonyms: inactive, submissive - Antonyms: active, assertive - 💡 Memory tip: גם דקדוק: passive voice. ### 1393. charismatic (adj.) - Definition: having personal charm - תרגום: כריזמטי - Example 1: A charismatic leader. - Example 2: His charismatic personality. - Synonyms: charming, magnetic - 💡 Memory tip: charisma (n). ### 1394. eccentric (adj.) - Definition: unconventional; unusual - תרגום: אקסצנטרי - Example 1: An eccentric artist. - Example 2: His eccentric behavior. - Synonyms: unusual, quirky - Antonyms: conventional - 💡 Memory tip: חריג מהרגיל. ### 1395. conventional (adj.) - Definition: traditional; usual - תרגום: מקובל, קונבנציונלי - Example 1: Conventional wisdom says... - Example 2: A conventional approach. - Synonyms: traditional, standard - Antonyms: unconventional, unusual - 💡 Memory tip: מ-convention (מוסכמה). ### 1396. innovative (adj.) - Definition: introducing new ideas - תרגום: חדשני - Example 1: An innovative design. - Example 2: Innovative thinking. - Synonyms: creative, original - body: # חבילת אוצר מילים #4 – רמת Expert ## חלק א': 150 פעלים (Verbs) - רמה מומחה מבנה: 150 פעלים ברמה הגבוהה ביותר - נדירים, ספרותיים, ופורמליים מאוד --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. פעלי הצהרה וטיעון מתקדמים (1501-1530) - 30 מילים 2. פעלי הערכה וביקורת עדינה (1531-1560) - 30 מילים 3. פעלי פעולה ספרותיים (1561-1590) - 30 מילים 4. פעלים פסיכולוגיים ורגשיים (1591-1620) - 30 מילים 5. פעלים פורמליים נדירים (1621-1650) - 30 מילים --- # 📢 קטגוריה 1: פעלי הצהרה וטיעון מתקדמים (30 מילים) ### 1501. proclaim (v.) - Definition: to announce officially and publicly - תרגום: להכריז בפומבי - Example 1: The king proclaimed victory. - Example 2: They proclaimed independence. - Synonyms: announce, declare - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד - הכרזה רשמית. ### 1502. pronounce (v.) - Definition: to officially declare; to articulate - תרגום: להכריז רשמית; לבטא - Example 1: The judge pronounced the verdict. - Example 2: How do you pronounce this word? Example 1: She expatiated on her travels. - Example 2: Don't expatiate too much. - Synonyms: elaborate, expound - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ונדיר. ### 1526. pontificate (v.) - Definition: to speak pompously - תרגום: לטעון בטון של מומחה - Example 1: He pontificates on politics. - Example 2: Stop pontificating! - Synonyms: lecture, preach - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי - מדבר כאילו הוא מומחה מוחלט. ### 1527. dictate (v.) - 40 מילים --- # 📖 קטגוריה 1: מושגים ספרותיים ורטוריים (40 מילים) ### 1651. rhetoric (n.) - Definition: the art of persuasive speaking - תרגום: רטוריקה - Example 1: His rhetoric was powerful. - Example 2: Political rhetoric can be misleading. - Synonyms: oratory, eloquence - 💡 Memory tip: rhetorical (adj). ### 1652. discourse (n.) - Definition: written or spoken communication - תרגום: שיח - Example 1: Academic discourse is formal. - Example 2: A philosophical discourse. - Definition: a short story - תרגום: אנקדוטה - Example 1: He told amusing anecdotes. - Example 2: Share an anecdote. - Synonyms: story, tale - 💡 Memory tip: סיפור אישי קצר. ### 1657. allegory (n.) - Definition: a story with hidden meaning - תרגום: אלגוריה, משל - Example 1: Animal Farm is an allegory. - Example 2: The allegory represents society. - Synonyms: symbolism, parable - 💡 Memory tip: סיפור עם פשר סמוי. ### 1658. parable (n.) - Definition: a simple story teaching a moral - תרגום: משל - Example 1: Jesus told parables. - Example 2: The parable teaches kindness. - Synonyms: allegory, fable - 💡 Memory tip: סיפור עם לקח. ### 1659. irony (n.) - Definition: the opposite of expected - תרגום: אירוניה - Example 1: The irony is striking. - Example 2: Dramatic irony creates tension. - Synonyms: sarcasm, paradox - 💡 Memory tip: ironic (adj). ### 1660. sarcasm (n.) - Definition: mocking with irony - תרגום: סרקזם - Example 1: His sarcasm hurt her. - Example 2: Dripping with sarcasm. - Synonyms: irony, mockery - 💡 Memory tip: sarcastic (adj). ### 1661. satire (n.) - Definition: humor that criticizes - תרגום: סאטירה - Example 1: The show is a political satire. - Example 2: Satire exposes corruption. - Synonyms: parody, mockery - 💡 Memory tip: satirical (adj). ### 1662. parody (n.) - Definition: a funny imitation - תרגום: פרודיה - Example 1: A hilarious parody of the film. - Example 2: Parody makes us laugh. - Synonyms: satire, spoof - 💡 Memory tip: חיקוי מצחיק. ### 1663. caricature (n.) - Definition: an exaggerated portrayal - תרגום: קריקטורה - Example 1: The caricature exaggerated his nose. - Example 2: A political caricature. - Synonyms: cartoon, parody - 💡 Memory tip: הגזמה מכוונת. ### 1664. prose (n.) - Definition: ordinary written language (not poetry) - תרגום: פרוזה - Example 1: Beautiful prose. - Example 2: Prose and poetry differ. - Synonyms: writing - 💡 Memory tip: הפוך מ-poetry. ### 1665. poetry (n.) - Definition: literary work in verse - תרגום: שירה - Example 1: I love poetry. - Example 2: Poetry expresses emotion. - Synonyms: verse, poems - 💡 Memory tip: poetic (adj). ### 1666. verse (n.) - Definition: poetry; a section of a poem - תרגום: שירה, בית - Example 1: A verse from the Bible. - Example 2: The second verse is beautiful. - Synonyms: poem, stanza - 💡 Memory tip: versatile מאותו שורש. ### 1667. stanza (n.) - Definition: a group of lines in a poem - תרגום: בית (בשיר) - Example 1: The first stanza is powerful. - Example 2: The poem has four stanzas. - Synonyms: verse - 💡 Memory tip: יחידה בשיר. ### 1668. narrative (n.) - Definition: a spoken or written account - תרגום: נרטיב, סיפור - Example 1: The narrative is compelling. - Example 2: Change the narrative. - Synonyms: story, account - 💡 Memory tip: מ-narrate. ### 1669. plot (n.) - Definition: the main events of a story - תרגום: עלילה - Example 1: The plot is complex. - Example 2: The plot thickens! - Synonyms: storyline, narrative - 💡 Memory tip: גם: קונספירציה. ### 1670. protagonist (n.) - Definition: the main character - תרגום: גיבור (ראשי) - Example 1: The protagonist fights evil. - Example 2: We identify with the protagonist. - Synonyms: hero, main character - Antonyms: antagonist - 💡 Memory tip: pro- = בעד. ### 1671. antagonist (n.) - Definition: the most intense point - תרגום: שיא - Example 1: The climax was thrilling. - Example 2: The story builds to a climax. - Synonyms: peak, high point - 💡 Memory tip: Plural: climaxes. ### 1673. denouement (n.) - Definition: the final part of a plot - תרגום: סיום - Example 1: The denouement surprised us. - Example 2: A satisfying denouement. - Synonyms: conclusion, resolution - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית - ספרותי מאוד. ### 1674. motif (n.) - Definition: a recurring theme or idea - תרגום: מוטיב - Example 1: Love is a common motif. - Example 2: The motif runs throughout. - Synonyms: theme, pattern - 💡 Memory tip: חוזר לאורך יצירה. ### 1675. theme - body: # 🏆 Mastery Level – 100 מילים ברמה ספרותית-אקדמית עליונה ## החבילה הסופית - מילים לשליטה מלאה מטרה: מילים נדירות, ספרותיות ואקדמיות ברמה הגבוהה ביותר באנגלית קהל יעד: תלמידים מצטיינים שמכוונים לציון 134+ (פטור מלא) מקורות: GRE, SAT, ספרות קלאסית, עיתונות איכותית (NYT, The Economist, New Yorker) אזהרה: אלו מילים מאתגרות. רבות מהן נדירות גם בקרב דוברי אנגלית ילידיים! --- ## 📋 קטגוריות: 1. פעלים ספרותיים-אקדמיים (2151-2180) - 30 מילים 2. שמות עצם נדירים ומתוחכמים (2181-2210) - 30 מילים 3. תארים מושכלים-ספרותיים (2211-2240) - 30 מילים 4. ביטויים אקדמיים גבוהים (2241-2250) - 10 מילים --- # 🎭 קטגוריה 1: פעלים ספרותיים-אקדמיים (30 מילים) ### 2151. extol (v.) - Definition: to praise enthusiastically - תרגום: להלל, לשבח עד מאוד - Example 1: Critics extolled her novel. - Example 2: He extols the virtues of patience. - Synonyms: praise, glorify, laud - 💡 Memory tip: הלל נלהב ופורמלי. מופיע ב-NYT. ### 2152. admonish (v.) - Definition: to warn or reprimand firmly - תרגום: להזהיר, לנזוף ברצינות - Example 1: The teacher admonished the students. - Example 2: She was admonished for her behavior. - Synonyms: reprimand, warn - 💡 Memory tip: אזהרה חמורה אך בונה. ### 2153. beleaguer (v.) - Definition: to surround with difficulties - תרגום: להציק, להציק ברציפות - Example 1: Beleaguered by problems. - Example 2: The city was beleaguered. - Synonyms: besiege, beset - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - קושי מתמשך. ### 2154. castigate (v.) - Definition: to criticize severely - תרגום: למתוח ביקורת קשה - Example 1: Critics castigated the film. - Example 2: He was castigated for his errors. - Synonyms: criticize, chastise - 💡 Memory tip: ביקורת חריפה. ### 2155. chastise (v.) - Definition: to criticize strongly - תרגום: לייסר, לנזוף - Example 1: Chastised for carelessness. - Example 2: She chastised him publicly. - Synonyms: castigate, scold - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי. ### 2156. exacerbate (v.) - Definition: to make worse - תרגום: להחמיר - Example 1: Stress exacerbates the problem. - Example 2: His words exacerbated tensions. - Synonyms: worsen, aggravate - Antonyms: alleviate, mitigate - 💡 Memory tip: מופיע בכתבות על פוליטיקה וכלכלה. ### 2157. mitigate (v.) - Definition: to make less severe - תרגום: להקל, למתן - Example 1: Measures to mitigate damage. - Example 2: Mitigate the risks. - Synonyms: alleviate, ease - Antonyms: exacerbate - 💡 Memory tip: הנגדי של exacerbate. ### 2158. alleviate (v.) - Definition: to make pain or difficulty less - תרגום: להקל - Example 1: Medicine alleviates pain. - Example 2: Policies to alleviate poverty. - Synonyms: ease, mitigate, relieve - 💡 Memory tip: הקלת סבל או קושי. ### 2159. ameliorate (v.) - Definition: to improve - תרגום: לשפר - Example 1: Ameliorate the conditions. - Example 2: Efforts to ameliorate the crisis. - Synonyms: improve, enhance - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי ואקדמי מאוד. ### 2160. obfuscate (v.) - Definition: to make unclear - תרגום: לטשטש, לערפל - Example 1: Don't obfuscate the truth. - Example 2: Politicians often obfuscate issues. - Synonyms: confuse, obscure - Antonyms: clarify, elucidate - 💡 Memory tip: להפוך לעמום במכוון. ### 2161. elucidate - already covered at #1523. ### 2161. disparage (v.) - Definition: to speak badly of - תרגום: לזלזל, להשמיץ - Example 1: Don't disparage others. - Example 2: She was disparaged publicly. - Synonyms: belittle, criticize - Antonyms: praise, extol - 💡 Memory tip: dis- = נגד. ### 2162. denigrate (v.) - Definition: to criticize unfairly - תרגום: להשמיץ - Example 1: Don't denigrate his work. - Example 2: Denigrating comments. - Synonyms: disparage, defame - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי - התקפה על שם. ### 2163. vilify (v.) - Definition: to speak evil of - תרגום: להכפיש - Example 1: The media vilified him. - Example 2: Vilified for his actions. - Synonyms: denigrate, defame - 💡 Memory tip: מ-vile (נבזה). ### 2164. lambaste (v.) - Definition: to criticize harshly - תרגום: לגנות בחריפות - Example 1: Critics lambasted the decision. - Example 2: He was lambasted in the press. - Synonyms: berate, criticize - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ועיתונאי. ### 2165. berate (v.) - Definition: to scold angrily - תרגום: לנזוף בזעם - Example 1: She berated him for lying. - Example 2: Don't berate yourself. - Synonyms: scold, reproach - 💡 Memory tip: נזיפה חזקה. ### 2166. reproach (v.) - Definition: to express disappointment - תרגום: להטיל אשמה, להוכיח - Example 1: She reproached him gently. - Example 2: I reproach myself. - Synonyms: rebuke, criticize - 💡 Memory tip: ביקורת עדינה יותר. ### 2167. repudiate (v.) - Definition: to refuse to accept - תרגום: לדחות, להתנער מ- - Example 1: Repudiate the accusations. - Example 2: He repudiated his earlier statements. - Synonyms: reject, renounce - 💡 Memory tip: דחייה פומבית ורשמית. ### 2168. reconcile - already covered. ### 2168. assuage (v.) - Definition: to make less intense - תרגום: להרגיע, לפייס - Example 1: Assuage her fears. - Example 2: Nothing could assuage his grief. - Synonyms: ease, calm - 💡 Memory tip: להרגיע רגשות חזקים. ### 2169. vex (v.) - Definition: to annoy or worry - תרגום: להרגיז - Example 1: The noise vexed him. - Example 2: A vexing problem. - Synonyms: annoy, trouble - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - הטרדה מתמשכת. ### 2170. placate - already covered in Package 4. ### 2170. galvanize (v.) - Definition: to shock into action - תרגום: לחשמל, לעורר לפעולה - Example 1: The speech galvanized the crowd. - Example 2: Galvanize supporters. - Synonyms: energize, inspire - 💡 Memory tip: מגלוון = מחשמל. ### 2171. mollify (v.) - Definition: to soothe anger - תרגום: לרכך, לפייס - Example 1: Tried to mollify her anger. - Example 2: His apology mollified them. - Synonyms: appease, placate - 💡 Memory tip: הרגעה של זעם. ### 2172. exonerate (v.) - Definition: to clear from blame - תרגום: לזכות מאשמה - Example 1: Evidence exonerated him. - Example 2: The court exonerated her. - Synonyms: acquit, absolve - Antonyms: convict, blame - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי - זיכוי. ### 2173. absolve (v.) - Definition: to declare free from guilt - תרגום: לזכות - Example 1: Absolved of all charges. - Example 2: The priest absolved his sins. - Synonyms: exonerate, pardon - 💡 Memory tip: משפטי ודתי. ### 2174. impugn (v.) - Definition: to challenge the truth of - תרגום: להטיל ספק ב- - Example 1: Impugn his integrity. - Example 2: Don't impugn her motives. - Synonyms: challenge, question - 💡 Memory tip: פורמלי מאוד - משפטי. ### 2175. extrapolate (v.) - Definition: to estimate beyond known data - תרגום: להסיק/לאמוד - Example 1: Extrapolate from the data. - Example 2: Extrapolate future trends. - Synonyms: infer, project - 💡 Memory tip: מ-extra + data. ### 2176. interpolate (v.) - Definition: to insert between existing elements - תרגום: לשלב, להוסיף בין - Example 1: Interpolate new data points. - Example 2: Comments were interpolated. - Synonyms: insert - 💡 Memory tip: מתמטי ולינגוויסטי. ### 2177. expound - already covered at #1524. ### 2177. pontificate - already covered. ### 2177. equivocate (v.) - Definition: to speak ambiguously to avoid committing - תרגום: להתחמק בדיבור - Example 1: Don't equivocate - answer! - Example 2: Politicians equivocate often. - Synonyms: hedge, prevaricate - 💡 Memory tip: להימנע מהתחייבות ברורה. ### 2178. prevaricate (v.) - Definition: to avoid telling the truth - תרגום: להתחמק, לפזל - Example 1: Stop prevaricating! - Example 2: He prevaricated about his past. - Synonyms: equivocate, lie - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי. ### 2179. dissemble (v.) - Definition: to conceal one's true motives - תרגום: להסוות - Example 1: She dissembled her feelings. - Example 2: Dissembling his intentions. - Synonyms: pretend, conceal - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי - להסתיר כוונות. ### 2180. procrastinate (v.) - Definition: to delay doing - תרגום: לדחות, להתמהמה - Example 1: Don't procrastinate - act now! - Example 2: He procrastinates constantly. - Synonyms: delay, postpone - 💡 Memory tip: נפוץ - דחיינות. --- # 🎩 קטגוריה 2: שמות עצם נדירים ומתוחכמים (30 מילים) ### 2181. zeitgeist (n.) - Definition: the spirit of the times - תרגום: רוח הזמן - Example 1: The zeitgeist of the 1960s. - Example 2: She captures the zeitgeist. - Synonyms: spirit of the age - 💡 Memory tip: מגרמנית - מופיע באנגלית מלומדת. ### 2182. sycophant (n.) - Definition: a person who flatters for gain - תרגום: חנפן - Example 1: Surrounded by sycophants. - Example 2: A sycophant has no real opinions. - Synonyms: flatterer, toady - 💡 Memory tip: שלילי מאוד. ### 2183. charlatan (n.) - Definition: a fake expert - תרגום: שרלטן - Example 1: A charlatan claiming to heal. - Example 2: Avoid charlatans online. - Synonyms: fraud, impostor - 💡 Memory tip: מזויף המתחזה למומחה. ### 2184. demagogue (n.) - Definition: a politician who appeals to emotions - תרגום: דמגוג - Example 1: A dangerous demagogue. - Example 2: Demagogues exploit fears. - Synonyms: rabble-rouser - 💡 Memory tip: מיוונית - מוביל העם (בשלילה). ### 2185. iconoclast (n.) - Definition: a person who attacks established beliefs - תרגום: שובר מוסכמות - Example 1: She's an intellectual iconoclast. - Example 2: Artistic iconoclasts. - Synonyms: nonconformist, rebel - 💡 Memory tip: שובר אליל (מיוונית). ### 2186. pariah (n.) - Definition: an outcast - תרגום: מנודה - Example 1: Treated as a social pariah. - Example 2: A political pariah. - Synonyms: outcast, untouchable - 💡 Memory tip: מהודית - ספרותי ועיתונאי. ### 2187. doyen (n.) - Definition: the most respected member - תרגום: הבכיר - Example 1: The doyen of physicists. - Example 2: He's the doyen of his field. - Synonyms: dean, senior - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית. ### 2188. maverick (n.) - Definition: a non-conformist - תרגום: עצמאי מאוד, מורד - Example 1: A political maverick. - Example 2: Known as a maverick. - Synonyms: individualist, nonconformist - 💡 Memory tip: מיוחד במינו. ### 2189. neophyte (n.) - Definition: a beginner - תרגום: מתחיל, טירון - Example 1: A neophyte in programming. - Example 2: Neophytes welcome. - Synonyms: beginner, novice - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי ויפה. ### 2190. connoisseur (n.) - Definition: an expert judge - תרגום: מבין, מומחה (בטעם) - Example 1: A wine connoisseur. - Example 2: An art connoisseur. - Synonyms: expert, authority - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית - איות מסובך. ### 2191. savant (n.) - Definition: a learned person - תרגום: מלומד - Example 1: A scientific savant. - Example 2: Musical savant. - Synonyms: scholar, genius - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית - "מי שיודע". ### 2192. polymath (n.) - Definition: a person of wide knowledge - תרגום: איש אשכולות - Example 1: Da Vinci was a polymath. - Example 2: A true polymath. - Synonyms: scholar, Renaissance man - 💡 Memory tip: poly- (רב) + math (למידה). ### 2193. raconteur (n.) - Definition: a skilled storyteller - תרגום: מספר סיפורים מוכשר - Example 1: A brilliant raconteur. - Example 2: Known as a great raconteur. - Synonyms: storyteller - 💡 Memory tip: מצרפתית. ### 2194. pundit (n.) - Definition: an expert giving opinions - תרגום: פרשן, מומחה - Example 1: Political pundits. - Example 2: A media pundit. - Synonyms: expert, commentator - 💡 Memory tip: מהודית. ### 2195. epithet (n.) - Definition: a descriptive word or phrase - תרגום: כינוי, תואר - Example 1: An insulting epithet. - Example 2: Her epithet was "Iron Lady". - Synonyms: nickname, title - 💡 Memory tip: ספרותי מאוד. ### 2196. euphemism (n.) - Definition: a mild word replacing a harsh one - תרגום: לשון נקייה - Example 1: "Passed away" is a euphemism. - Example 2: A corporate euphemism. - Synonyms: polite term - 💡 Memory tip: eu- = טוב. ### 2197. hyperbole (n.) - Definition: exaggeration - תרגום: הגזמה - Example 1: "I could eat a horse" is hyperbole. - Example 2: Advertising uses hyperbole. - Synonyms: exaggeration - 💡 Memory tip: סגנון ספרותי. ### 2198. oxymoron (n.) - Definition: a figure of speech combining opposites - תרגום: אוקסימורון - Example 1: "Deafening silence" is an oxymoron. - Example 2: "Jumbo shrimp" is an oxymoron. - Synonyms: contradiction - 💡 Memory tip: שילוב של הפכים. ### 2199. cacophony (n.) - Definition: a harsh sound -
